title: Subcellular RNA fractions of HSV-1 infected primary human fibroblasts including infection with delta-Vhs mutant
summary: Primary human foreskin fibroblasts (HFF) were infected with wild-type simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) strain 17 or its vhs null mutant at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 10. Subcellular RNA fractions including total RNA, cytoplasmic RNA, nucleoplasmic RNA and chromatin-associated RNA were prepared and subjected to RNA-seq.

title: Targeting eIF4F Translation Initiation Complex with SBI-756 Sensitizes B Lymphoma Cells to Venetoclax
summary: Through the study of translation regulation, we identify the disruption of eIF4F assembly as a promising approach to enhance venetoclax efficacy in non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma.

title: Identify the master regulator of ILT3.Fc induced perturbation in Jurkat cells
summary: Generate gene expression profile of ILT3.Fc treated Jurkat cells

title: Identification of required host factors for SARS-CoV-2 infection in human cells [RNA-seq]
summary: RNA-seq was performed to determine gene expression (RNA) levels and SARS-CoV-2 viral reads in A549-ACE2 cells treated with DMSO or Amlodipine.
design: ACE2-A549s cells were treated with either DMSO or amlodipine (Millipore Sigma, Cat #A5605) resuspended in DMSO one hour before infection. Amlodipine was used at a concentration of 10uM. A549-ACE2 cells were infected at MOI of 0.1 with SARS-CoV-2 for 24 hours before harvest. RNA-seq libraries were built from 1ug of RNA per sample using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit (Illumina) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Sequencing libraries were sequenced using an Illumina NextSeq 500 platform and fastq files were generated using bcl2fastq (Illumina). Reads were aligned to hg19 using STAR aligner via the RNA-Seq Alignment application (Basespace, Illumina). Alignments to the SARS-CoV-2 genome (GenBank: MN985325.1) were determined using bowtie (Robinson et al., 2010).

title: Differential gene expression profiles by septin 2 suppression and TNF-a treatment in human microvascular endothelial cells
summary: Arrangements of juntional proteins of endothelial monolayers were altered by both septin 2 KD and TNF-a treatment. Therefore, differential gene expression profiles by septin 2 KD comapred to control and TNF-a treatment compared to untreat were analyzed using RNA-seq.

title: RNAseq from nasopharyngeal swab RNA prior to intranasal live attenuated influenza vaccine in children
summary: The goal of this study was to identify pre-challenge transcriptomic signatures associated with viral replication of LAIV strains in the nasopharynx.

title: A FOXO-dependent replication checkpoint restricts proliferation of damaged cells
summary: DNA damage results in the activation of a transcriptional program that promotes DNA repair and stalls cell cycle progression. To determine which transcriptional programs are induced by replication stress, we determined the transcriptome of aphidicolin-treated RPE-1 cells.

title: SMA cases and postnatal controls from spinal cord, diaphragm and iliopsoas tissues
summary: The objective of the study was to compare gene expression across SMA cases and postnatal controls in spinal cord, diaphragm and iliopsoas tissues. This dataset was used in the testing of the GENDULF algorithm.

title: Transcriptomic data of MDA-MB-231 cells adapted to culture in media containing 0 mM or 2 mM metformin and cultured as mammospheres
summary: We report the single-cell RNA sequencing data obtained from MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells cultured in standard DMEM (high glucose) media, or adapted to culture in standard DMEM (high glucose) media containing 2 mM metformin, and then cultured as mammospheres

title: Nascent-seq data from DRB-treated/untreated human U2OS cell line
summary: Confluent U2OS cells were released to serum-free medium, and continued to grow for 36 h (Per2-dLuc peak) or 48 h (Per2-dLuc trough), then added DRB (10uM) treatment for 0.5, 1.5, 3.5 h, then added BrU (250uM) for 0.5 h, harvested total RNA, captured with anti-BrU antibody, and conduced hi-seq.

title: Analysis of 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 genomic action reveals calcium regulating and calcium independent effects in mouse intestine and human enteroids
summary: The objective of this study was to determine how the differentiated and undifferentiated compartments of the human duodenum and colon epithelium respond to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 via human enteroids
design: mRNA Profiles of human enteroids (differentiated and undifferentiated) treated with Control (Ethanol) or 1,25D3 (Vitamin D) for 24 hours with a total of 48 samples

title: Whole blood transcriptomes of patients receiving digital subtraction angiography
summary: Circulating whole blood transcriptomes can detect the presence of unruptured cerebral aneurysms. Pending additional testing in larger cohorts, this could serve as a foundation to develop a simple blood-based test to facilitate screening and early detection of cerebral aneurysms.

title: Genome-wide characterization of platinum persister ovarian cancer (OC) cells with upregulation of Wnt pathway receptor, Frizzled 7 (FZD7)
summary: The goal of this study is to define molecular signature of platinum persister OC cells characterized by FZD7, and investigate the functional role of FZD7 relative to stemness and chemo-responsiveness.

title: RNA sequencing from T47D and MCF-7 breast cancer cells
summary: We report the RNA sequencingn onT47D and MCF-7 cells infected by either vehicle or shMEN1 virus

title: Differences in tissue populations following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in Crohn’s disease patients
summary: Treatment of severely refractory Crohn’s disease (CD) patients remains a clinical challenge. Recent studies show the efficacy of autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) in these severely compromised patients. HSCT is thought to eliminate auto-reactive cells; however, no specific studies of immune reconstitution in CD patients are available. We studied a group of CD patients (n=18) receiving autologous HSCT and non-IBD patients (n=19) to elucidate the mechanism of interaction with the microorganisms.
design: Biopsy mRNA profiles of CD patients undergoing HSCT were generated by deep sequencing, using HiSeq4000 platform (Illumina, San Diego, CA)

title: Hydroxychloroquine inhibits trained immunity
summary: We demonstrate that hydroxychloroquine inhibits trained immunity at the functional and epigenetic level and is accompanied by reduced expression of interferon-stimulated genes. Trained immunity comprises a functional adaptation induced by epigenetic reprogramming which facilitates the anti-viral innate immune response.
design: We performed ChIP sequencing and RNA sequencing on trained monocytes that are treated with HCQ, and RNA-seq on monocytes from COVID-19 patients that were treated with HCQ.

title: scRNAseq of human iPSC-derived motor neurons from control and ALS patients.
summary: We compare single cell transcriptomic profiles of motor neurons differentiated in vitro from human induced pluripotent stem cells derived from control and ALS patients.

title: Gene expression profiling reveals insights into infant immunological and febrile responses to capsular group B meningococcal vaccine
summary: We report gene expression profiles, using RNA-sequencing, in whole blood samples taken before and after  infant immunisations.

title: RNA sequencing reveals the transcriptomic profile of human neuroblastoma SK-N-BE(2) cell line after MCM6 interfered by small interfering RNA
summary: Minichromosome maintenance complex component 6 (MCM6), as an important replication permission factor, is involved in the pathogenesis of various tumors. we studied the expression of MCM6 in neuroblastoma and its influence on tumor characteristics and prognosis, and we found MCM6 has significant effect on tumor growth promotion. To investigate the underlying mechanism that MCM6 in neuroblastoma, we compared the transcriptomes of siRNA interfered MCM6 and negative control neuroblastoma cells.

title: Obesity in cardiac surgery patients
summary: We report on the application of RNA sequencing to study expression changes in cardiac surgery patients of different obesity categories.

title: Interleukin-11 signaling drives vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and contributes to aortic remodelling
summary: RNA sequencing of primary human aortic or arterial VSMCs after stimulation with transforming growth factor beta-1 (TGFβ1) revealed marked IL11 upregulation. In vitro, IL11 stimulation of VSMCs resulted in phenotypic switching by increased ECM production and migration/invasion. Neutralizing IL11 antibody treatment abolished phenotypic switching in VSMCs. IL11 plays an important and non-redundant role in VSMC phenotypic switching.

title: Hemopexin is a novel tumor suppressor that blocks cancer metastasis by modulating heme:DNA G-quadruplex dynamics to control c-myc expression
summary: Treamtent of PC3 prostate cancer cell line results in enhanced colony growth and c-myc expression. Further, heme promotes tumro growth and metasease in in vivo models of carcinogenesis

title: STAU1 selectively regulates the expression of inflammatory and immune response genes and alternative splicing of nerve growth factor receptor signaling genes
summary: To study the potential targets and functions of STAU1 which might be related to neuropathic pain, we obtained STAU1-regulated transcriptome in HeLa cells. High-throughput  RNA sequencing(RNA-seq) were performed for HeLa cells and control cells to define the comprehensive gene expression profiles and identify the genome-wide alternative splicing events regulated by STAU1.

title: RNA sequencing keloid transcriptome associates keloids with Th2, Th1, Th17/Th22 and JAK3-skewing
summary: In this study, we aimed to elucidate the profile of lesional and non-lesional keloid skin compared to normal skin. We performed gene (RNAseq, qRT-PCR) and protein (immunohistochemistry) expression analyses on biopsy specimens obtained from lesional and non-lesional skin of African American (AA) keloid patients compared to healthy skin from AA controls. We found that lesional versus normal skin showed significant up-regulation of markers of T-cell activation/migration (ICOS, CCR7), Th2- (IL-4R, CCL11, TNFSF4/OX40L), Th1- (CXCL9/CXCL10/CXCL11), Th17/Th22- (CCL20, S100As) pathways, and JAK/STAT-signaling (JAK3) (false-discovery rate [FDR]<0.05).

title: Super Enhancer Regulation of Cytokine-Induced Chemokine Production in Alcoholic Hepatitis [RNA-Seq]
summary: Super enhancer in liver propagates inflammatory signaling by super enhancer-mediatedinducing chemokine expression and is the therapeutic potential of BET inhibition in Alcoholic hepatitis(AH) treatment.

title: Type 2 Diabetes reduces the enteroendocrine GLP-1 cell lineage in human obesity:  characterization in enriched human enteroendocrine cells
summary: Obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D) can be associated with altered secretion of enterohormones in condition that remains to be understood in depth. Here, we aimed to decipher the mechanisms by which a major enterohormone GLP-1, is decreased in human obese patients according to their diabetic status.

title: Gene expression of the A375 melanoma cell line treated with RAF inhibitors Vemurafenib  and  time-course with EGF stimulation during Vemurafenib RAF inhibitor treatment alone or with the MEK inhibitor Cobimetinib
summary: We treated for 24 hours the BRAF-V600E  melanoma cell line A375 with 7 doses of the RAF inhibitor Vemurafenib and, in a second experimental desing, we treated for 24 hours the BRAF-V600E  melanoma cell line A375 with Vemurafenib (1 uM) alone or in combination with the MEK inhibitor Cobimetinib (1 uM) and subsequently stimulated with EGF in a time-course of 7 time points for up to 8 hours (0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8 hours).
design: We measured mRNA levels of the A375 cell line treated for 24 hours with 7 doses of the RAF inhibitor Vemurafenib in the range 0.001-10 uM and, in a second experimental design, mRNA levels of the A375 cell line treated for 24 hours with the RAF inhibitor Vemurafenib (1 uM) alone or in combination with the MEK inhibitor Cobimetinib (1 uM) and subsequently stimulated with EGF (100 ng/mL) in a time-course up to 8 hours

title: Transcriptomic analysis of Kidney Machine normothermic perfusion and comparision to cold storage
summary: Kidneys which had been taken for transplant but later declined were perfused for up to 4 hours using a normothermic perfusion (MNP) rig or left on ice (CS) and samples were taken for RNASeq at different time points. The effect of the addition of a heamoadsorber (HA) to the perfusion rig was also assessed.

title: The regulation of gene expression by LSD1 in MCF-7 cells
summary: We performed RNA-Seq analysis of differentially expressed genes in WT and LSD1 KD MCF-7 cells to understand the regulation of gene expression by LSD1.In addition, we report the ChIP-Seq analysis of LSD, H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 binding sites in the genome of WT and LSD1 KD MCF-7 cells.

title: Transcriptome analysis of CHAF1B depletion in Akata EBV+ Burkitt Lymphoma cells
summary: RNAseq was used to identify host and EBV viral transcriptome changes in CHAF1B knock-out Akata EBV+ cells. CHAF1B KO Akata EBV+ cells were subjected to RNAseq analysis. The Akata EBV+ cells expressing control sgRNA was used as the control.
design: CHAF1B KO Akata EBV+ cells and control Akata EBV+ cells were subjected to RNAseq analysis.

title: Identification of a Midkine-associated gene expression profile in melanoma cells
summary: We performed gain-of-function (GoF) and loss-of-function (LoF) analyses of Midkine in melanoma cells by RNA-seq.

title: Base editing improvement
summary: We examined the off-targets of new base editing tools at RNA level
design: cells transfected with different base editing tools or GFP were cultured for 48 hours and total RNA was purified for transcriptome analysis

title: Whole transcriptome sequencing in human cervical adenocarcinoma and normal cervical tissues
summary: mRNA, lncRNA, and miRNA signatures were identified to discriminate cervical adenocarcinoma from normal cervix by whole transcriptome sequencing. We confirmed the RNA-seq data in another cohort of clinical cervical tissue samples by qRT-PCR.We demonstrated that miR-192-5p/HNF1A-AS1/VIL1 panel could accurately discriminates adenocarcinoma from normal cervix. Moreover,we also identified the circRNA expression profiles in cervical adenocarcinoma tissues and explored the function roles and mechanisms of circular RNA circEYA1 and circSPIDR in cervical adenocarcinoma cells.

title: BRAFV600E or mutant MAP2K1 human CD34+ cells establish Langerhans cell-like histiocytosis in immunodeficient mice
summary: We describe a xenograft model for human LCH-like disease in which we transduced human Cord Blood CD34+ HSPCs with a virus coding for BRAF-V600E - the most abundant pathognomonic somatic mutation occuiring in LCH. Cells were subsequently subjected to RNA-sequencing or transplanted into humanized MISTRG or NSG mice.
design: CD34+ Cord Blood HSPCs were transduced with a Lentivirus coding for BRAF-V600E and GFP or with a control virus containing a GFP- and a Luciferase contruct instead of BRAF-V600E and were then kept in vitro for 5 days. Samples were then sorted for GFP expression and subjected to bulk RNA sequencing.

title: Quantitative Analysis of different NK cell types Transcriptomes
summary: We compared transcriptome of different types of NK cells including obtained from peripheral Blood (PB-NK), derived from human ES cell, H9-NK, derived from human iPSC (iPSC-NK), derived from CD34+ cells from umbilical cord blood (UCB-NK), NKcell line (NK92) and 3 cancer cell lines (K562, Raji and Jurkat). When comparing the similarity of the NK cells populations by the number of differentially expressed genes to iPSC NK cells, there were the fewest differentially expressed genes in the comparison with the UCB NK cells, followed by the PB-NK cells, followed by the H9 embryonic stem cell derived-NK cells and lastly by the NK92 cell line.

title: Genetic alterations of SUGP1 mimic mutant-SF3B1 splice pattern in lung adenocarcinoma and other cancers
summary: RNA-sequencing data from HEK293T and HAP1 cell models: Hek293T (SF3B1-K700E, SF3B1-WT, SUGP1-KD and siContol), HAP1 CRISPR-isogenic cell lines WT and SUGP1-P636L

title: Search for a novel diagnostic marker for liver cancer.
summary: Analysis of the circular RNA expression proﬁles of tumor and normal tissue samples from Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).Find potential circular RNA to serve as diagnostic marker for liver cancer.

title: Gene expression for circFAM120A knockdown by RfxCas13d/BSJ-gRNA or shRNA in human 293FT cells
summary: Deep sequencing datasets are used for gene expression analysis. Knockdown of circFAM120A by BSJ-gRNA or shRNA revealed that the BSJ-gRNA-mediated knockdown showed a much higher correlation with gene expression compared to shRNA.

title: "TRADES": Targeted RNA demethylation by Suntag system
summary: We engineered a new m6A editing system consisting of GCN4 (SunTag)-dCas13b, anti-GCN4 single chain variable fragment (scFv)-FTO or ALKBH5-GBI and sgRNA to provide an applicable method to remove m6A modification at specific loci.

title: Gene expression profiling from glutamine-depleted and -replete H460 cells.
summary: We performed RNA-seq to compare immune modulators in glutamine-deprived versus glutamine-replete cancer cells.
design: RNA-seq was performed on glutamine-depleted and -replete H460 cells in triplicate, using LEXOGEN QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq Library Prep Kit (Cat#015.96).

title: Transcriptome and Retrotranscriptome profiling in HIV infected women with Breast Cancer (RNA-seq)
summary: In order to determine the impact of HIV infection on the breast cancer microenvironment, we sequenced total RNA from formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) breast cancer samples of 10 women (4 HIV-positive: 6 HIV-negative) for studying the transcriptome and retrotranscriptome of those. We performed RNA extraction from samples stored for more than 5 years, cDNA library preparation, total RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and differentially expressed genes between conditions were analyzed.

title: Epigenetic modification of the COX-2/PGE2 pathway modulates macrophage phenotype and cell-targeted manipulation improves diabetic tissue repair
summary: RNA-sequencing techniques to profile the transcriptomes of lesional skin of diabetic patients

title: Wnt Signaling Mediates Oncogenic Synergy Between Akt and Dlx5 in T-Cell Lymphomagenesis by Enhancing Cholesterol Synthesis [primary tumor RNA-seq]
summary: Akt2;Dlx5 double transgenic mice develops T-ALL, and these cells have up regulated Cholesterol synthesis via Wnt pathway for survival

title: RNA sequencing of transgenic TNNT2 variant models
summary: We identify genetic alterations in TNNT2 HCM and DCM

title: RNA Transcriptome of Tregs in Idiopathic Aplastic Anemia
summary: Our report demonstrates that the dominant Treg population in AA are FasL resistant but do not respond to low concentration of IL-2, leading to immune dysregulation. And In vitro expanded AA Tregs are stable, functional and highly express p-BCL-2 with therapeutic potential in AA patients

title: Transcriptome analysis of normal human lung fibroblasts (NHLFs) following FOXL1 knockdown.
summary: FOXL1 is a key transcription factor that characterizes the pulmonary origin of lung fibroblasts.. RNA-sequencing analysis on NHLFs following FOXL1 knockdown revealed a broad array of genes possibly regulated by FOXL1.

title: Hyperactive CDK2 Activity in Basal-like Breast Cancer Imposes a Genome Integrity Liability that can be Exploited by Targeting DNA Polymerase Epsilon
summary: RNAseq data for MDA-MB-231, CAMA-1, and MCF7 cells expressing shPOLE and either a vector control or cDNA POLE rescue

title: RNA-seq of patient-derived melanoma cells depleted for GLI1 and SOX2
summary: We report the RNA-seq of melanoma cells depleted for SOX2 and GLI1. Three pairs of total RNAs from each condition were generated for library preparations and subsequent RNA-seq. All samples had over 50 million reads with over 93% of the reads mapping to the human genome (obtained from the UCSC Genome Browser assembly ID:hg19). Using differential expression analysis (fold change (FC)>1.5, false discovery rate (FDR)<0.1 as standard cut-offs), we identified 1104 entities commonly altered in both SOX2- and GLI1-knocked down cells. We grouped genes into enrichment clusters revealed by DAVID functional annotation tool (https://david.ncifcrf.gov/).
design: Examination of the top pathways significantly downregulated in both SOX2-and GLI1-depleted melanoma cells and identification of SOX2/GLI1 commonly regulated genes

title: Anti-cancer activity of Cotyledon orbiculata extract
summary: We investigated the effects of the crude extract of a South African medicinal plant, Cotyledon orbiculata, on cell survival of colon (HCT116) cancer cell lines. Using RNASeq, we discovered that the extract interfered with mRNA regulatory pathways. Here, we found that the extract of Cotyledon orbiculata, a South African medicinal plant, had an anti-proliferative effect in cancer cells, mediated by apoptosis induced by alternative splicing of hnRNPA2B1 and BCL2L1.

title: Modulation of Syndecan-1/4 reduces the invasive potential of endometrioma through TGF-β signalling
summary: We report that modulation of high SDC -1/-4 within certain endometriomas in women having ovarian endometriosis, reversed its higher invasion potential and downregulated several molecules incolved in cancer development.

title: Inhibition of CXCR1/2 in human colitis-derived pluripotent stem cell intestinal organoids attenuates the inflammatory phenotype
summary: We report the results of RNA-Seq on iPSCs, Definitive Endoderm (DE), Spheroids (Sph), and induced human intestinal organoids (iHIOs) from colitic and normal primary patient colon tissues

title: HnRNP-L regulated circCSPP1/miR-520h/EGR1 axis modulates autophagy and promotes progression in prostate cancer
summary: To explore the downstream autohphagy-related genes modulated by circCSPP1, we constructed circCSPP1 overexpression stable cell line (DU145-circCSPP1 cells) and accquired mRNA profiles by RNA sequencing.

title: Effects of FZR1 knockout on gene expression of breast tumor cells treated with cisplatin
summary: We knockout FZR1 in T-47D breast cancer cell line, and treated the knockout and WT cells with cisplatin. The mRNA profiles were analyze.

title: Effect  of overexpression on miR-486-5p in Healthy doncor CD34+ cells
summary: We report the effect of overexpression of miR-486-5pin heathy donors hematopoietic stem cells

title: Effects of spheroid and adherent growth conditions in ovarian cancer
summary: Purpose: To understand the changes in RNA expression in tumor-initiating cell (TIC) (spheroid) and non-TIC populations (adherent) in ovarian cancer. Methods: OV90 cells were grown in adherent (non-TIC) or spheroid (TIC) conditions. Total RNA was extracted from each condition and RNAseq was performed and analysed for differential gene expression between the conditions.

title: Ca2+ release-activated Ca2+ entry is a potent host innate immune defence against influenza A virus
summary: Gene expression was determined for normal human bronchial epithelial (NHBE) cells incubated with DMSO or TG immediately prior to infection with USSR H1N1 virus for 12 hours. All of the NHBE cell stocks were obtained from QIAGEN.
design: Normal human bronchial epthelial cells  mRNA profiles were generated by deep sequencing, in quadruplicate (two donors and two replicates per donor), using Illumina HiSeq 3000

title: SMARCB1 loss interacts with neuronal differentiation state to block maturation and impact cell stability
summary: We conducted  RNA sequencing of control and SMARCB1 knockdown cells at various neural differentiation states
design: RNA sequencing of control and SMARCB1 knockdown cells by shRNA or CRISPRi knockdown at iPS, neural progenitor and neuron state induced with knockdown during the differentiation process or post-differentiation.

title: Single-cell transcriptomics analysis of pancreatic primary tumor and metastatic biopsy tissues
summary: The single-cell RNA profiles of dissociated 10 pancreatic primary tumors and 6 metastatic biopsies were obtained using the 10x Genomics Chromium platform

title: Human fetal and pediatric primary gastric samples and organoids derived from them
summary: Reliable modelling of human stomach development and in vitro derivation of mature subsets of gastric epithelial cells has been challenging to achieve in 3D cultures. We derived fetal gastric organoid cultures from 8-20 post-conception week (PCW) stomachs, and post-natal controls from pediatric biopsies.

title: ZFP90 promotes colorectal carcinogenesis and stemness [RNA-seq]
summary: To elucidate whether  ZFP90 plays a role in  colorectal cancer tumorigenesis, a RNA-seq analysis was performed to compare the gene expression profiles of  ZFP90-KO and control Control cell.

title: Expression of SARS-CoV-2 receptor ACE2 and coincident host response signature varies by asthma inflammatory phenotype
summary: Identification and characterization of gene expression using Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) of mRNA sequence from  bronchial epithelial cells (BEC) obtained from asthma patients with varying clinical disease severity

title: The eukaryotic translation initiation factor eIF4E elevates steady-state m7G capping of coding and noncoding transcripts
summary: Methyl-7-guanosine (m7G) “capping” of coding and some noncoding RNAs is critical for their maturation and subsequent activity. Here, we discovered that eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E(eIF4E), itself a cap-binding protein, drives the expression of the capping machinery and the increased capping efficiency of ∼100 coding and noncoding RNAs. This dataset collects transcriptomic data for quantitative cap immunoprecipitation (CapIP) assay in eIF4E-Flag or vector stable U2Os cells.

title: The molecular subtype in colorectal cancer
summary: To dissect the the molecular subtype of colorectal cancer, we performed  RNA expression profiling in 53 CRC tissues.

title: Small RNA sequencing of H19X KD cell line
summary: The H19X RNAi knockdown cell lines were generated, and  both miRNA and piRNA expression were compared in H19X KD cell line compared with control

title: Ribosome profiling in DDX3X degron cell lines and covering variants
summary: We describe the subset of transcripts that require DDX3 for efficient translation.

title: Estrogen receptor beta repurposes EZH2 to suppress oncogenic NFκB signaling in triple negative breast cancer [RNA-Seq]
summary: The purpose of this study was to elucidate the transcriptome of ERβ expressing MDA-MB-231 cells following treatment with veh, E2, TNFα, or E2+TNFα.
design: ERβ-expressing MDA-MB-231 cells were treated with ethanol vehicle or 1nM E2 for 5 days, followed by 3 hours of 20ng/ml TNFα in replicates of 3.

title: Properties of PD1+ B cells in Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) Patients
summary: We study a new pathogenic, glycolytic PD1+ B cell population in sites of inflammation of patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA).

title: Transcriptomic profile of cord blood B cells and thymic B cell subsets in human neonates
summary: We reported two major thymic B cell subsets (CD21+CD35+ and CD21-CD35-) with different morphology, functions and transcriptome profile. For this purpose, mRNA was extracted from cord blood CD19+ B cells and thymic B cells (CD21+CD35+ and CD21-CD35-) from neonatal donors ranged between 1 day and 4 months and sequenced using Illumina HiSeq4000.

title: Effects on imidazoacridinone C-1311 on the transcriptomic profile in prostate cancer cell depending on their AR status.
summary: Human prostate cancer cells, LNCaP (AR+) and DU-145 (AR-), were treated with C-1311 to identify the transcriptomic profile and functionally relevant androgen-dependent and independent genes using RNA sequencing.

title: Next generation RNA-sequencing of YAP and TAZ knockdowns in mel537 melanoma cells
summary: The goals of this study are to compare NGS-derived transcriptome profiling (RNA-seq) data sets between siScrambled negative control groups and YAP, TAZ, or YAP/TAZ knockdown groups

title: GSF1635: RNA-seq data of OVCAR3-DAB2IP expressing cells vs. control
summary: Ovarian cancer (OC) is the leading cause of death from gynecologic malignancies in the US. Ovarian cancer stem cells (OCSCs) have been shown to drive chemoresistance and tumor  progression but the mechanism remains incompletely understood. Disabled Homolog 2-  Interacting Protein (DAB2IP) is a potent tumor suppressor identified in multiple types of cancers  and we demonstrate that DAB2IP is silenced by the repressive epigenetic mark H3K27me3 at  the DAB2IP promoter loci in OCSCs.

title: RNA-seq analysis of liver cancer patients' plasma
summary: Liver cancer is one of the most lethal cancers worldwide. Liquid biopsy provides a noninvasive approach in detecting and monitoring cancer biomarkers to overcome current limitations associated with tissue biopsies, comprising the analysis of circulating tumor-derived material. In this study, we profiled plasma cell-free RNA-seq to identify recurrently dysregulated RNA biomarkers for the liquid biopsy of cancer.

title: RNA-seq for hand-microdissected glomeruli from Immunoglobulin A nephropathy patients
summary: We collected glomeruli from biopsy specimens from IgA nephropathy patients with relatively preserved kidney function (eGFR ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 and urine protein-to-creatinine ratio < 3 g/g) and from normal kidney cortices by hand microdissection and performed RNA-seq. The transcriptomic profiling of IgA nephropathy glomerulus provide insights for intraglomerular pathophysiology of IgAN before reaching profound kidney dysfunction.

title: Impact of ZFAND3 knockdown on whole-genome gene expression in GBM cells
summary: ZFAND3 was beforehand identified to be invasion essentiel in GBM cells using genome-wide shRNA library screen to identify invasion-defective and invasion-essentiel genes. The knockdown of ZFAND3 decreases invasion behaviour of GBM cells. To determine the differences in gene expression upon knockdown, whole-genome RNA sequencing was performed.

title: RNA sequencing on A549 lung cancer cell line
summary: We report the RNA sequencing on A549 lung cancer line with 40 nM TP-0903 treatment.

title: RNA sequencing on HT29 colorectal cancer cell line
summary: We report the single cell RNA sequencing on HT29 colorectal cancer line with 100 nM dasatinib treatment after double thymidine block.
design: Investigate potential resistant pathways in colorectal cancer cell after dasatinib treatment.

title: Gene expression in drug-resistant and circulating tumor cell cultured H460 or A549 cells
summary: Gene expression in drug resistant and circulating tumor cell cultured H460 or A549 cells

title: Integrated mRNA/miRNA-seq of Caco-2 and HT-29 cells under chemical hypoxia (cobalt chloride, oxyquinoline)
summary: To uncover hypoxia-induced miRNA-mRNA interactions landscape in colorectal cancer cell lines we performed integrated miRNA/mRNA sequencing of Caco-2 and HT-29 cells. Hypoxia was chemically induced via 24 h cobalt(II) chloride and oxyquinoline treatments.
design: The experiment included CoCl2-treated, oxyquinoline-treated and control Caco-2, HT-29 cells, three biological replicated per group were used.

title: cGAS-mediated induction of type I interferon due to inborn errors of histone pre-mRNA processing
summary: A disturbance of histone protein composition renders nuclear DNA immunogenic, inducing a type I interferon response to self.

title: Transcriptional responses of GII.4 human norovirus infection in jejunal human intestinal enteroids
summary: The goal of this project was to evaluate intestinal epithelial responses to GII.4 human norovirus infection.

title: Identification of potential target genes of KRAB zinc-finger proteins in cancer cells
summary: KRAB zinc-finger proteins (KZFPs) are potent transcriptional suppressors and suspected to be associated with cancer progression. To identify the potential target genes of KZFPs in lung adenocarcinoma cells, we established a panel of A459 cell lines that over-express 30 types of KZFPs (A549/KZFP cells) and performed RNA-sequencing (RNA-Seq) analysis of these cells.

title: CD73 contributes to anti-inflammatory properties of afferent lymphatic endothelial cells in humans and mice
summary: The aim of this study is to compare gene expression differences between human lymphatic endothelial cells after they have been treated with siRNA or with different CD73-blocking antibodies. In addition also the gene expression differences after antibody-blocking in human blood endothelial cells are determined.

title: In-depth analysis of proteomic and genomic fluctuations during the time course of human embryonic stem cells directed differentiation into beta cells
summary: We describe fluctuations in the correlation between gene expression, its protein abundance, and phosphorylation, which follow beta-cell differentiation protocol perturbations of stem cell fates

title: A predictable conserved DNA base composition signature defines human core DNA replication origins
summary: Here, we identify DNA replication initiation sites from 19 human samples, representing three untransformed and three immortalized cell types using SNS-seq protocol.

title: Transcriptome profile of a stable clone overexpressing TFEB in HEK293 cells by TET-OFF system (HEK293-PFL-TFEB).
summary: In order to identify the transcriptomic effects of TFEB overexpression, we performed a time series RNASeq experiments

title: Intracranial aneurysm sequencing data
summary: Based on sequencing technology to evaluate the differential lncRNA and mRNA expression of intracranial aneurysms. Provide ideas for the study of epigenetic regulation of intracranial aneurysms

title: Transcriptomic analysis of APC knock down HCEC 1CT cells compared to the wild type HCEC 1CT cells.
summary: We performed RNA sequencing analysis of two human colon epithelial cell lines (HCEC 1CT_WT and HCEC 1CT_APC KD).
design: Expression profiles of HCEC 1CT_WT and APC KD cells were generated by RNA sequencing, in triplicate, using Illumina NextSeq 500.

title: Transcriptomic and functional deficits in human TREM2-/- microglia impair response to Alzheimer's pathology in vivo [bulk RNA-seq]
summary: Bulk RNA sequencing data comparing TREM2 WT and KO microglia responses to treatment with dead neurons.

title: LncRNA AC010789.1 promotes colorectal cancer progression by targeting microRNA-432-3p/ZEB1 axis and the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway
summary: Accumulating literatures have indicated that long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are crucial molecules in tumor progression in various human cancers, including colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the clinical significance and regulatory mechanism of a vast majority of lncRNAs in CRC remain to be determined. The current study aimed to explore the function and molecular mechanism of lncRNA AC010789.1 in CRC progression.

title: Herpes simplex encephalitis in a patient   with a new form of  inherited IFNAR1 deficiency
summary: Inborn errors of TLR3-dependent IFN-α/β- and -λ-mediated immunity in the central nervous system (CNS) can underlie herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) encephalitis (HSE). The respective contributions of IFN-α/β- and -λ are unknown. We report a child homozygous for a genomic deletion of the entire coding sequence and part of the 3’UTR of the last exon of IFNAR1, who died from HSE at the age of two years. An older cousin died following vaccination against measles, mumps and rubella at 12 months of age, and another 17-year-old cousin homozygous for the same variant has had other viral illnesses. The encoded IFNAR1 protein is expressed on the cell surface but is truncated and cannot interact with the tyrosine kinase TYK2. The patient’s fibroblasts and EBV-B cells did not respond to IFN-α2b or IFN-β, in terms of STAT1, STAT2 and STAT3 phosphorylation, or the induction of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs). Transcriptome analysis revealed a complete abolition of genome-wide ISG induction in response to IFN-α2b in IFNAR1-deficient fibroblasts from the patient. These fibroblasts were susceptible to viruses, including HSV-1, even in the presence of exogenous IFN-α2b or IFN-β. HSE is therefore a consequence of inherited complete IFNAR1 deficiency. This experiment of Nature indicates that IFN-α/β are essential for anti-HSV-1 immunity in the CNS.

title: Transcriptomes of MCSF- and MUC1-ST-treated monocyte derived human macrophages
summary: RNAseq was used to analyse transcriptomic differences between matched healthy human MCSF-treated macrophages and MUC1-ST-treated macrophages

title: Single cell RNAseq reconstruct normal and IPF lung epithelium
summary: Tissue fibrosis is a common pathological outcome of chronic disease that markedly impairs organ function leading to morbidity and mortality. In the lung, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is an insidious and fatal interstitial lung disease associated with declining pulmonary function.  Single cell RNA sequencing was used to map epithelial cell types of the normal human airway and alveolaor as well as IPF explant tissue.

title: RNA-Seq analysis of BEAS-2b cells stimulated with house dust mite extract with or without suppression of MD-2
summary: We clarified MD-2 might have a protective role in house dust mite(HDM)-induced asthmatic characteristics. The purpose of RNA-Seq analysis is to identify transcriptional events regulated by MD-2 in HDM-stimulated airway epithelial cells.

title: EZH2 identifies the precursors for trained immunity of human natural killer cells
summary: Human NK cells were treated with IL-12/15/18 to induce trained immunity.  scRNA-seq and TotalSeqTM were performed to map the development pathway of trained NK cells.

title: RNA-seq of HEK 293T cells treated with Val-boroPro
summary: We report the application of RNA-seq for profiling gene transcription upon treatment of dipeptidyl peptidases 8 and 9 inhibitor, Val-boroPro (VbP). We find no significant changes in gene transcription upon treatment of mammalian cells with Val-boroPro.

title: Immune signature driven by ADT-induced immune microenvironment remodeling in prostate cancer is correlated with recurrence-free survival and immune infiltration
summary: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) is a cornerstone treatment for locally advanced or metastatic prostate cancer (PCa). However, its potential effects on the tumor immune microenvironment (TIM) of PCa patients and the underlying mechanism remain largely unclear.We used RNA sequencing to reveal the effects of ADT on the PCa TIM at the transcriptome level. RNA sequencing was performed on 6 paired pre-ADT biopsy and post-ADT PCa lesions and 5 paired paracancerous benign tissues from patients receiving neoadjuvant ADT with locally advanced PCa.
design: RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed on 6 paired pre-ADT biopsy and post-ADT PCa lesions and 5 paired paracancerous benign tissues from patients receiving neoadjuvant ADT with locally advanced Pca.

title: Expression analysis after co-treatment of GSK126 and pomalidomide
summary: To determine combination effect of GSK126 and pomalidomide at the RNA levels in EZH2 Y641 mutant DLBCL, We performed gene expression profiling in WSU-DLCL2 cell line after co-treatment of GSK126 and pomalidomide

title: Metformin improves cognition of aged mice by promoting cerebral angiogenesis and neurogenesis [hADSCs]
summary: We implemented transcriptomic analyses of hADSCs treated with metformin 6 days
design: hADSCs treated with metformin 6 days

title: Single-cell functional pharmacogenomics reveal cell decision information within gene expression noise
summary: Single HeLa cells were treated with tumor necrosis factor-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL, 25ng/ml, 50min) to determine their response profiles (“high” or “low”) by live-cell microscopy using a FRET sensor of capase-8 dynamics, a predictor of “cell death” or “cell survival”, respectively. Based on their response profile, cells were isolated by laser-capture microdissection and analyzed by single-cell RNA sequencing to determine the gene expression signature associated with their drug response profile.

title: Description of transcriptome in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines without KEAP1/NRF2 mutations in response to an electrophilic reagent dimethylmaleate (DEM)
summary: We report DEM-induced changes in the transcriptome of ABC1 and HCC4006 cell lines.

summary: We report NRF2-dependent changes in the transcriptome of A549, H460 and H2023 cell lines.

title: Reciprocal regulation of EGR1 and EZH2 in breast cancer cells
summary: We found that EGR1 stimulates the expression of EZH2, which in turn inhibited the expression of EGR1 through a silencer region and deletion of the silencer resulted in upregulation of EGR1, which reduced the malignancy of breast cancer cells.

title: Transcriptome of thyroid cancer (TC) cells after coculture with TC-induced macrophages
summary: RNA sequencing data of TPC-1  cells (TC cell line) after co-culture with TC-induced macrophages. We used an in vitro co-culture model of a human TC cell line, TPC1 (RET/PTC rearrangement), and human primary monocytes.

title: Validation of AS1 as novel regulator of tumor resistance to immune cell attack
summary: The experiment was performed to verify wether knockdown of AS1 in combination with TNFa treatment affected the signature of genes involved in tumor cell apoptosis and survival

title: Transcriptomic Analysis of Control and PLX4032 Resistant Clones with RNA Sequencing
summary: NGS-derived transcriptome profiling (RNA-seq) of control and PLX4032 resistant clones to identify resistance-associated gene-expression changes and pathway enrichments, and to integrate with exome and methylome analysis. Results provide insight into PLX4032 resistance in BRAF V600E melanoma.

title: Novel lncRNA KILN siRNA knockdown in human aortic smooth muscle cells (HASMCs)
summary: The goal of this study is to define the transcriptome regulated by novel lncRNA KILN under baseline and proinflammatory conditions

title: RNA sequencing analysis of gene expression profiles of OLFM4-RET fusion in HEK293 cells
summary: The purpose of this assay is to determine the gene expression profiles induced by OLFM4-RET fusion, therefore further understanding the molecular mechanim of oncognesis by OLFM4-RET

title: Selective activation of FZD7 in human pluripotent stem cells
summary: Human pluripotent stem cells ( (H1/WA01/NIH stem cell registry number 0043) were treated with WNT3a protein, a FZD7-specific WNT mimetic, and a GSK3 inihibitor in time series to determine genes differentially upregulated and downregulated across all conditions or within one condition only.

title: The ubiquitin ligase TRIM37 controls cancer-specific vulnerability to PLK4 inhibition
summary: We show synthetic lethality between PLK4 inhibition-mediated centrosome loss and the overexpression of the ubiquitin ligase TRIM37 in cancer cells with amplification of Chr17q
design: Compare the effect of differential TRIM37 expression on global gene expression in untransformed hTERT RPE1 and neuroblastoma CHP-134 cells.

title: Temporal control of species-specific motor neuron differentiation [Hs]
summary: How species-specific developmental timing is controlled is largely unknown. By following human embryonic stem cell (hESC) and mouse stem cell (mESC) differentiation to motor neurons through detailed RNA-sequencing time courses, we wish to find if there is a global scaling factor between species

title: Transcriptomic Characterization of neuroblastoma by Single Cell RNA Sequencing
summary: Neuroblastoma (NB) is the most common malignant solid tumor in the abdomen of children, with high degree of malignancy, poor prognosis and unknown pathogenesis. So we aim to investigate intra-tumor heterogeneity of neuroblastoma at single cell resolution.

title: Novel cancer-selective and disease subtype-independent mechanistic targets of withaferin A in human breast cancer cells
summary: We report differential gene expression changes by withaferin A in breast cancer cells versus a normal mammary epithelial cell line.
design: Examination of withaferin A-regulated transcriptome in a normal mammary epithelial cell line (MCF-10A) and human breast cancer cells belonging to different subtypes including MCF-7 (luminal type), SK-BR-3 (HER2 enriched type), and MDA-MB-231 (basal type).

title: RNAseq of U87/over-expressed DPF3 U87 treated with bulk control/0.5mM 8-cpt-cAMP combination with 1nM MS275 for 48hrs
summary: Transcriptomics revealed that the combination of 8-cpt-cAMP and MS275 could maximize the glioma differentation compared to control or use either drug alone

title: RNA-Seq analysis of sorted hematoendothelial populations from the human embryo dorsal aorta
summary: This dataset contains RNA-Seq data for sorted hematoendothelial subpopulations from the ventral (AoV) and dorsal (AoV) portions of the CS15-16 human embryo dorsal aorta. This includes endothelial (VC+CD45-), Hematopoietic Stem/Progenitor Cells (VC+CD45+) and more mature hematopoietic cells (VC-CD45+) from both the AoV and AoD.

title: Anti-lymphoma activities of different compounds
summary: 4 lymphoma cell lines (DOHH2, OCILy10, TMD8 and Toledo) have been treated with DMSO, CB103, NEO02734 or OTX015. The transcriptome has been sequenced after 6hrs from the treatment. The gene expression levels have been compared in order to elucidate the differencies and similarities for the different drugs compare to DMSO (control group).
design: Transcriptome profiles of 6hrs and 14days for 6 lymphoma cell lines treated with DMSO, Vorinostat and Pracinostat.

title: RNA-sequencing and Exome-sequencing analysis of ferroptosis-resistant 786-O GPX4-null carcinoma cells following in vivo selection
summary: We have used in vivo selection to isolate GPX4 knockout 786-O cells that have evaded ferroptosis in vivo in mouse xenograft experiments. RNA-seq and Exome-seq profiling were performed to characterize the mechanisms underlying ferroptosis evasion in these in vivo-derived ferroptosis resistant cells.

title: RNA stability measurements in RBMS1 knockdown cells and control cells
summary: In order to identify RBMS1-dependent changes in RNA stability, RBMS1 levels in SW480 breast cancer cells were stably knocked-down using short-hairpin RNAs. The cells were then treated with alpha-amanitin to inhibit transcription, RNA was isolated at 0 and 9 hours post-alpha-amanitin treatment, and the samples were transcriptomically profiled.

summary: We compared gene expression in RBMS1 knockdown and control cells in the SW480 background.

title: Total RNA sequencing of AKAP12 knockdown cells
summary: We compared gene expression in AKAP12 knockdown and control cells in the SW480 background.

title: RNA-seq of ATF-3 overexpressing and Neomycin control melanoma cell lines
summary: The present study demonstrates that ATF-3 plays a tumor suppressing function in melanoma. title: Transcriptome analysis of HT1080 cells expressing HA-hZFAT-EGFP and EGFP
summary: We report the effects of overexpression of ZFAT on mRNA profiles in HT1080 cells.

title: Effects of PAK4 knockdown on gene expression in glioblastoma-associated endothelial cells
summary: PAK4 was knocked down in human glioblastoma (GBM)-associated endothelial cells (ECs) using CRISPR-Cas9/gRNA. RNA was isolated and analyzed by RNAseq. The effects of PAK4 knockout on gene expression were determined.
design: ECs were isolated from GBM tumors and transduced with the lentivirus expressing PAK4 sgRNA or control sgRNA, followed by cell selection by incubation with medium containing 2 µg/ml puromycin. RNA was isolated and analyzed by RNAseq.

title: FKBP4 knockdown effect on the gene expression of H1975 cells
summary: H1975 cells were transfected with FKBP4 targeting shRNA and the control shRNA, then mRNA were extracted for high-throughput sequencing.

title: Kidney Cancer PDOX Models
summary: RNA seq of two independent kidney cancer orthotopic patient-derived xenograft models (RenPDOX-13 & RenPDOX-50) that show differential proinvasive response to antiangiogenics

summary: Single cell transcriptome and TCR sequencing of FACS-sorted memory T cells in one patient under treatment with the anti CD38-antibody Daratumumab. The patient received Daratumumab at days 0, 7, 14 and 21. Analyses were performed on day 0, 41 and 74.

title: RNA-Seq expression profiling of clonal populations from the OCI-C5x patient-derived ovarian clear cell carcinoma cell line
summary: Intratumoral heterogeneity is well-recognized but its impact on tumor progression is unclear. Here, we derived unbiased clonal populations from OCI-C5x, a patient-derived ovarian clear cell carcinoma cell line, and assessed their tumorigenicity and tracked their fate during tumor progression. Results provide insight into intratumoral heterogeneity of clear cell carcinoma transcriptomes.

title: Single cell gene expression analysis of stem cell-derived cerebral organoids treated with Methamphetamine
summary: To study the effects of fetal brain exposure to methamphetamine, embryonic stem cell-derived cerebral organoids were treated with methamphetamine and cell type-specific gene expression was analysed using scRNA-seq.
design: 8 cerebral organoids were mock treated and 6 cerebral organoids were treated with 5uM methamphetamine for 7 days before being enzymatically dissociated and analyzed by scRNA-seq using the 10x Genomics platform.

title: Transcriptome Profiling of Neutrophils from Patients Infected with IAV using RNA-seq
summary: Purpose: To explore the roles of host lncRNAs during IAV infection Methods:profiling whole transcriptional alterations using RNA-seq in neutrophil samples from 3 patients infected with IAV in the acute stage and their matched recovery-stage samples Results:We identified a total of 404 differentially expressed genes (FC>2, p<0.05), including 234 up-regulated and 170 down-regulated genes,in each patient sample Conclusion:Our study is the first profile of the transcriptome of IAV-infected patients' neutrophils

title: Digital Gene Expression profiles analysis of patients with HCV-related hepatic fibrosis
summary: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection is an important etiology of chronic liver disease. Multiple possible molecular mechanisms were involved in the progression of liver fibrosis in chronically HCV-infected patients. Therefore, the further revealing novel genes for regulating liver fibrosis might provide evidence for gene diagnosis and molecular-targeted therapy. In this study, we examined the differentially expressed mRNA in plasma samples from the healthy control and patients with HCV-related liver fibrosis, in order to explore the potential predicted and therapeutic target for the development of HCV-related liver fibrosis.

title: Expression profiling of lung cancer cells reconstituted with SMARCA4 WT and mutant K785R after SMARCA2 knockdown
summary: Using RNA-seq, we identified the expression changes in lung cancer cells (NCI-H1944) transduced with control or SMARCA2-targeting hairpins. The ID of this project in Genentech's ExpressionPlot database is PRJ0034746

title: Next Generation Sequencing Analysis of Human Glioblastoma Transcriptomes And Quantitative Analysis of PDGFRA Positive/Negative Human Glioma Cells Transcriptomes
summary: We report the high-throughput profiling of thirteen human glioblastoma and four pairs of panned(pdgfra+) and supernatant(pdgfra-) human glioma cells. title: Transcriptional profiling of hepatocyte, reprogrammed hepatocyte, and biliary cells [human]

title: Comprehensive molecular features of polycystic ovary syndrome revealed by transcriptome analysis of oocytes and cumulus cells
summary: We aimed to elucidate the molecular features and identify causative factors for PCOS through an integrated, transcriptomic analysis of oocytes and cumulus granulosa cells (GCs) from the same patients with PCOS

title: T47D cells; Anastrozole RNA-seq
summary: The objective of the RNAseq is to identify genes regulated by anastrozole, and the difference in genes regulated by anastrozole and estradiol.

title: Effects of Tesamorelin on Hepatic Transcriptomic Signatures in HIV-Associated NAFLD
summary: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a common comorbidity among people living with HIV with a more aggressive course than in the general population. In a recent randomized placebo-controlled trial, we demonstrated that the growth hormone-releasing hormone analogue tesamorelin reduced liver fat and prevented fibrosis progression in HIV-associated NAFLD over one year. In the current study, we leveraged paired liver biopsy specimens from this trial to identify hepatic gene pathways that are differentially modulated by tesamorelin versus placebo to gain key insights into the biological underpinnings of its clinical effects.

title: Colon, rectum and rectal tumor organoids. Effects of calcitriol (active form of Vitamin D) treatment
summary: We have established three-dimensional (3D) organoids from healthy colon and rectum tissue and from tumor tissue of patients with rectal cancer. Global transcriptomic analyses reveal differences in gene expression between these stem cell-derived cultures and distinct response to vitamin D.

title: Hypoxia Triggers the Intravasation of Clustered Circulating Tumor Cells
summary: Circulating tumor cells (CTCs) are shed from solid cancers in the form of single or clustered cells, with the latter displaying an extraordinary ability to initiate metastasis. Yet, the biological phenomena that trigger the intravasation of CTC clusters are largely unknown. Here, we compare gene expression of hypoxic and normoxic CTC clusters to identify genes that are not only upregulated as a consequence to hypoxia, but that may also play a pivotal role in promoting CTC clusters generation and metastasis.

title: RNA-seq of human RUES2 and iPSC derived CMs at day 15 of differentiation
summary: The definition of lncRNAs conservation remain a crucial challenge. In order to identify more promising relevant cardiac ncRNAs, we selected transcripts also present in human cardiac cells. We performed total RNA-seq  in human RUES2 and iPSC derived cardiomyocyte at day 15  of differentiation, first for human transcripts identification and secondly for the orthologous selection.

title: Mechanisms of immune evasion in P. falciparum malaria revealed by integrative gene expression profiling [RNA-seq]
summary: We performed a genome-wide profiling of miRNAs and mRNA, DNA sequencing of human whole blood sample to identify miRNAs responsive to P.falciparum (P.f) infection and/or associated with parasite load. We identified a set of 72 miRNAs that are positively or negatively associated with parasitemia. We also performed expression quantitative trait loci of miRNAs(miR-eQTL) of P.f infected individuals. The miR-eQTL dataset allowed us to determine relevant genetic variant responsible for miRNAs expression differences between P.f infected individuals and find novel malaria-associated miRNAs

title: Quantitative transcriptome analysis of human embryonic stem cells, human mesenchymal stem cells and human musculoskeletal stem cells
summary: We first derived human musculoskeletal stem cells from human embryonic stem cells. mRNA profiles of human embryonic stem cells, human mesenchymal stem cells and human musculoskeletal stem cells were generated by QuantSeq 3’ mRNA-sequencing, in triplicate, using NextSeq 500.

title: PRKCQ-dependent transcriptome in MyLa and HuT 78 cells
summary: Transcriptional profiling controlled by PRKCQ of human CTCL cell lines MyLa and HuT 78 comparing cells transfected with non-targeting control with shPRKCQ cells at resting conditions and by TPA. The objective was to explore the role of PRKCQ in the pathogenesis of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma(CTCL).

summary: We measured changes in gene expression after treatment of human breast cancer cell lines with abemaciclib.

title: RNA-sequencing experiments to identify differentially expressed genes between Wild Type and RBM4 KO HAP1 cell line samples
summary: Here, we implemented a computational pipeline to determine the correlation of expression between individual RBPs and ERVs from single-cell or bulk RNA sequencing data. summary: Expression profiles of SB-3CT treated A375 human melanoma cell lines and vehicle control group with or without induced by IFN-γ.
design: Expression profiles were generated from SB-3CT treated A375 human melanoma cell lines with or without induced by IFN-γ, which were collected to extract total RNA, and mRNA sequencing was performed.

title: Transcriptome profiling to determine molecular mechanisms of acquired EGFR TKI resistance
summary: The goal of this study was to compare the transcriptome (RNA-seq) of EGFR TKI sensitive NSCLC cells with that of cells with acquired resistance to erlotinib.  HCC827 and HCC4006 cells were continuously cultured in erlotinib until erlotinib resistant (ER) variants emerged.  All ER variants were negative for T790M. RNA from parental and ER cells was isolated for transcriptomic profiling.  RNA-seq analysis reveals that EGFR TKI resistance is associated with a mesenchymal gene expression signature.

title: Gene expression changes in hiPS-derived cardiomyocytes under R-2HG exposure and doxorubicin treatment
summary: RNA sequencing and immunostaining in hiPS-derived cardiomyocytes indicated that the oncometabolite R-2HG exacerbated doxorubicin mediated cardiotoxicity.
design: To validate whether R-2HG increases myocardial vulnerability to anthracyclines, we exposed human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPS)-derived cardiomyocytes to 1μM doxorubicin (DOX) with or without the addition of R2-HG.

summary: Purpose: RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) has revolutionized systems-based analysis of cellular pathways. The goals of this study are to compare NGS-derived transcriptome profiling (RNA-seq) to microarray and quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT–PCR) methods and to evaluate protocols for optimal high-throughput data analysis

title: Myosin 7b is a regulatory long noncoding RNA (lncMYH7b) in the human heart [adenovirus either expressing GFP or MYH7b_sp]
summary: We have discovered that the alternative splice form of MYH7b is a regulatory non-coding RNA in the human heart. This dataset contains a forced expression of a peptide encoded by a short ORF at the beginning of the alternate splice form (MYH7b_sp) in cardiomyocytes.

title: KDM5A and PHF2 positively control expression of pro-metastatic genes repressed by EWS/Fli1, and promote growth and metastatic properties in Ewing Sarcoma
summary: The goal of this study was to understand the role of the chromatin factors KDM5A and PHF2 in Ewing Sarcoma progression.

title: Glucocorticoids enhance the anti-leukemic activity of FLT3 inhibitors in FLT3 mutant acute myeloid leukemia
summary: Utilizing genome wide transcriptome analysis and drug screen we demonstrate that upregulation of inflammatory pathways is a key mechanism of drug tolerance to FLT3 targeted inhibitors in AML
design: Performed RNA-seq after isolating cells that survive treatment with DMSO or quizartinib for 48h or after recovery in drug free media for 13 or 30 days. title: Comprehensive analysis of Transcriptome Profiles in Hepatocellular Carcinoma patients
summary: Purpose: The goal of this study is to get a comprehensive evaluation of the transcriptome profile of HCC patients Methods:Transcriptome profiles of paired Tumor and adjacent non-tumour from 25 HCC patients were generated by deep sequencing using the Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform. Paired sample T-test was used to identify differentially expressed genes between Tumours and adjacent non-Tumours. Results: A total of 4462 genes are differentially expressed genes between tumours and adjacent non-tumours Conclusions: Characterization of the transcriptome profiles of HCC patients reveals key genes and pathways that are deregulated in HCC patients.

title: Human CXCR5+CD45RA-CD8+ T cells subset in follicular lymphoma
summary: We demonstrate that CXCR5+CD8+ T cells are a distinct human T-cell subset that homes to follicles and exerts strong antitumor activity compared with CXCR5-CD8+ T cells. Importantly, this subset is associated with improved outcome in follicular lymphoma patients.

title: BMPR2 Regulates Hypoxic Exosome Signaling to Maintain Vascular Homeostasis
summary: Endothelial cells (EC) sense stimuli in the circulation and release responsive signaling molecules to coordinate the multicellular adaptations required to maintain vascular homeostasis. The goal of this study were to analyze the transcriptional changes induced by hypoxia in control donor pulmonary arterial endothelial cells and the effect of loss of BMPR2 that is associated with pulmonary arterial hypertension.
design: 24 samples analyzed, 2 biolgoical and 2 technical replicates, siBMPR2 or siControl treated, 3 timepoints of hypoxia treatment (0, 6, 24 hours).

title: pan-cancer single cell RNA-seq analysis of cell lines
summary: To understand the diversity of expression states in cancer cell lines, we profiled 198 cancer cell lines by single-cell RNA-seq with 10X chromium.

title: Myosin 7b is a regulatory long noncoding RNA (lncMYH7b) in the human heart
summary: We have discovered that the alternative splice form of MYH7b is a regulatory non-coding RNA in the human heart. This dataset contains manipulation of levels of lncMYH7b in human cardiomyocytes.

title: RNA-seq analysis of MCF7 cells treated with abemaciclib, SR11302
summary: We measured changes in gene expression in MCF7 with CDK4/6 and AP-1 inhibition by abemaciclib and SR11302, respectively.

title: Atopic dermatitis displays stable and dynamic skin transcriptome signatures
summary: To gain a deeper understanding of the atopic dermatitis (AD) skin transcriptome and the effects of systemic treatment with dupilumab and cyclosporine, we conducted a gene expression study of AD using mRNA-Seq data generated from lesional and non-lesional skin biopsies collected from patients included in the TREATgermany registry. We are able to provide deep characterisation of AD skin transcriptomic signatures by using an assortment of bioinformatic approaches such as differential expression, co-expression network and pathway enrichment analysis.
design: We performed mRNA sequencing of 166 skin transcriptomes obtained from 57 patients with moderate to severe AD recruited in the TREATgermany registry between July 2017 and February 2019 at six out of 17 study centres which agreed to participate in the additional and optional bioanalytics module. Follow-up biopsies 3 months after the initiation of systemic treatment were available from 21 (dupilumab) and 8 (cyclosporine) patients. Non-lesional samples were taken at least 5 cm from the active lesion.

title: Comparison of bioprinted kidney organoids in different conformations
summary: Bulk RNA-seq comparison of kidney organoids bioprinted in 3 different conformations with varying starting cell densities. Density is dictated by the ratio of bioprinter tip movement to  the amount of extrusion, where higher ratios spread cells over a larger surface area. We compare organoids printed with no movement ('blob', ratio 0) to those with moderate ('line 3', ratio 20) or high movement ('line 1', ratio 40).

title: Generation of functional hepatocytes from extended pluripotent stem cells
summary: We established efficiently differentiation protocol of human extented pluripotent stem (EPS) cells to functional hepatocytes (EPS-Heps) by simply adding a pre-treatment step before applying the directed differentiation protocol for conventional human pluripotent stem cells. Importantly, compared to hepatocytes derived from conventional human pluripotent stem cells, EPS-Heps transcriptionally more resemble primary human hepatocytes.

title: A Phase 2 Randomized, Double-blind Pilot Study of IL-17-Targeting with 2 Secukinumab in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis

summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.

title: IER5 is required for Notch-mediated induction of squamous cell differentiation [RNA-seq]
summary: Conditional activation of Notch in squamous cells activates a context-specific gene  expression program through lineage-specific regulatory elements. IER5 is a direct Notch-regulated gene and required for  Notch-induced differentiation of squamous carcinoma cells.

title: RGS2-mediated translational control drives cellular dormancy and resistance to ER-stress-induced apoptosis by inducing proteasome-mediated ATF4 degradation
summary: Slow-cycling/dormant cancer cells (SCCs) are thought to cause cancer relapse, but the underlying biology remains obscure. A subpopulation of SCCs has been found even in rapidly growing tumors and cancer cell lines. To investigate the mechanism underlying cellular dormancy, we obtained SCCs from three NSCLC cell lines (H460, H1299, and SK-MES-1) and PDX tumor by using a cell proliferation-dependent fluorescent dye (CSFE).

title: Comparative analysis of cellular heterogeneity in the LAM lung using scRNA-seq
summary: Investigate detailed cellular composition of the LAM lung compared to the age and sex matched healthy control, in order to isolate LAM-lung-specific cellular states or subtypes.

title: Transcriptomic sequencing of breast cancer
summary: We did transcriptomic sequencing of blood samples from 6 breast cancer patients. Total RNA were extracted from peripheral blood and library were constructed for the illumina Xten sequencing. We did transcriptomic sequencing of adjacent normal tissues and cancer tissues from 6 breast cancer patients. Total RNA were extracted and library were constructed for the illumina Xten sequencing.

title: Global assessment of integrated stress response in CF patients lung explants and organoids
summary: Freshly acquired lung tissue from CF patients with advanced disease and prolonged exposure to pathogenic microorganisms display a clear molecular signature of activated unfolded protein response (UPR) and chronic inflammation.

title: Next genereration sequencing reveals that CNAs associated with cyclin E overexpression tranlate into changes in transcriptional output.
summary: Transient cyclin E overexpression in human mammary epithelial cells leads to a distinct CNA signature. We carried out high throughput sequencing to determine if these CNAs translated into changes in transcription.

title: Gene expression profiling data following TRIM8 knockdown in MCF-7 cells
summary: Breast cancer (BC) is the most common female malignancies worldwide, and 70% of cases are estrogen receptor α (ERα) positive. In this study, we report that the E3 ubiquitin ligase TRIM8 acts as a novel regulator of ER signaling. TRIM8 is downregulated in BC and is associated with poor prognosis. In addition, the protein level of TRIM8 is negatively correlated with ERα expression. To investigate whether TRIM8 mediated estrogen signaling pathway, we generated a knockdown model of TRIM8 in human MCF7 cells.
design: Gene expression profiling of MCF-7 cells were transfected with TRIM8 siRNA or control siRNA. Three biological replicates were used for each group.

title: Cis-acting lnc-eRNA SEELA1/2 in leukemia progression
summary: Long non-coding enhancer RNAs (lnc-eRNAs) are a subset of stable eRNAs identified from the annotated lncRNAs. They might serve as enhancer activity-related therapeutic targets in cancer; however, the epigenetic activation mechanisms and the function of lnc-eRNAs in cancer initiation and progression remain largely unknown.Here, by genome-wide screening we firstly identified a set of lncRNAs as lnc-eRNAs according to the epigenetic signatures of enhancers.To demonstrate the functional roles of lnc-eRNAs, two newly identified lnc-eRNAs, SEELA1 and SEELA2, were chosen for further studies.Further studies showed that SEELA1/2-SERINC2 axis regulated cancer metabolism, such as sphingolipid synthesis, to affect the leukemia progression.

title: Transcriptomics analysis of mesenteric adipose tissue from Crohn's disease patients and healthy controls [RNA-seq]
summary: A feature of Crohn's disease is the extra-intestinal manifestation of creeping fat, defined as expansion of mesenteric adipose tissue around the inflamed and fibrotic ileum. In comparison to healthy controls, we found that the greatest transcriptional changes in creeping fat are functions related to immune response to bacterial products.

title: Epigenetic drugs selectively target a population of AML cells which are positive for CD123 cell surface markers and are chemoresistant II

title: YY1 Interacts with G quadruplex DNA to Regulate Gene Expression
summary: We systematically analyzed the alterations in mRNA transcriptome evoked by knockdown of YY1 with or without pyridostatin (PDS) treatment. Statistical analysis showed a strong correlation between PDS-regulated and YY1-regulated genes (Pearson r > 0.67), underscoring the role of YY1-G4 structure interaction in YY1-mediated gene regulation. Moreover, the RNA-Seq results revealed that YY1 can positively or negatively regulate the expression of genes through its interaction with G4 structures.

title: Dysregulation of p53-RBM25-mediated circAMOTL1L biogenesis contributes to prostate cancer progression (RNA-seq data set)
summary: To clarify the effect of p53 on RBP gene expression, we knocked out p53 gene in PC3 cells to generate p53 knockout stable cell line (p53-/- PC3 cells) and examined the expression of the known RBP genes by RNA sequencing.

summary: To understand the role of diptoindonesin G in the regulation of differentiation of breast cancer cells, the gene expression profile of MDA-MB-231 cells treated with diptoindonesin G was analyzed using Hiseq deep sequencing.

title: Transcriptome reprogramming via Tob2-promoted global mRNA turnover
summary: We found that multilayered phosphorylation of human Tob2 modulates its PABP-binding ability to change global deadenylation and mRNA turnover, which in turn reprograms transcriptome to influence cell proliferation.

summary: We profiled RNA expression in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes from patients with LZTR1-associated Noonan syndrome

title: Transcriptome profiling of A549 RB1 wild-type/knockout cell lines
summary: A549 cells were co-transfected with CRISPR/Cas9 (containing sgRNA and GFP) and HDR donor plasmids (containing RFP and puromycin). The genetic editing cells were selected by puromycin. And then, we performed RNA sequencing for transcription profiling of A549 RB1 RB1 wild-type/knockout cell lines. The raw data were processed with Tophat and cuffdiff for gene expression analysis.

title: FBXO11 is a candidate tumor suppressor in the leukemic transformation of myelodysplastic syndrome
summary: This experiment is assocaited with a publication defining a tumor supressor role of FBXO11 in the transformation of MDS. We observe decreased expression of FBXO11 is associated with transformation to secondary AML.

title: Genome-Wide Profiling of DNA Methylation and Gene Expression Identifies Candidate Genes for Human Diabetic Neuropathy (RNA-Seq)
summary: We perfomed transcriptomic and methylomic analysis of sural nerve biopsies from type 2 diabetic patients with neuropathy. Sural nerve transcriptomic and methylomic profiles were integrated and subsequent biological meaning investigated using KEGG pathway analysis of overlapping differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and differentially methylated genes (DMGs). A gene interation network was also generated including DEGs and DMGs, and common biological pathways were identified.

title: IGF2BP1 is a targetable SRC/MAPK-dependent driver of invasive growth in ovarian cancer
summary: We identified IGF2BP1 as a marker of the C5 molecular subtype of high-grade ovarian carcinoma (HG-SOC). IGF2BP1 promotes SRC activity and ERK2 expression enhancing the tolerance towards SRC- and MEK-directed inhibitors saracatinib and selumetib. Combination treatment overcomes IGF2BP1-promoted resistance.

title: Innate, non-cytolytic CD8+ T cell-mediated suppression of HIV replication by MHC-independent inhibition of virus transcription
summary: MHC-I-restricted, virus-specific cytotoxic CD8+ T cells control HIV/SIV replication via the recognition and killing of productively infected CD4+ T cells. Several studies in SIV-infected macaques suggest that CD8+ T cells may also decrease virus production by suppressing viral transcription. RNA sequencing is used to identify candidate cellular pathways that are involved in the virus-silencing mediated by these CD8+ T cells.

title: Gamma-secretase inhibition does not affect gene expression in squamous cell carcinoma cells that do not express Notch1
summary: As part of a larger study on the role of Notch1 activation in squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), these control data sets were generated to study the effect of gamma-secretase inhibition on SCC cells that do not express Notch1. We found that no genes are significantly changed in response to gamma-secretase inhibition.

title: Stem cell-derived neutrophil-primed progenitors prevent lethal infection
summary: We show that engineered neutrophil-primed progenitors derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells (NeuPs-XL) can produce functional neutrophil-like cells (NeuCs-XL) that can act promptly in vivo against lethal bacterial infections at a clinically applicable scale. We performed global gene expression profiling of NeuPs-XL and NeuCs-XL with or without LPS stimulation.
design: gene expression profiling of NeuPs-XL and NeuCs-XL with or without LPS stimulation

title: Transcriptome profiling of human peritoneal mesothelial cells grown in static and stretching conditions
summary: RNA-Seq was used to characterize the changes induced by mechanical stretching on the gene expression profile of human peritoneal mesothelial cells.

title: Gene expression profiling of MDA_MB_231 cell line in response to treatment with Dexamethasone and SH4-54
summary: To determine how the transcription factors GR and STAT3 cooperate to regulate gene expression, the MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cell line was treated with dexamethasone (1µM for 24 hours) and the STAT3 inhibitor SH4-54 (8µM for 24 hours) alone and in combination. A multivariate linear model with a GR:STAT3 interaction term was used to identify genes that are differentially expressed when both TFs are fully active in the nucleus.
design: MDA-MB-231 cells were plated in 6-well plates at ~300,000 cells in 4ml of media per well and grown for 24 hours. Three replicates wells were treated for 24 hours with 1µM of Dexamethasone (DEX), 8µM SH4-54, no treatment, or a combination of DEX and SH4-54. The cells were lysed using Qiagen RLT buffer and 1% BME.

summary: To understand the recurrence of ovarian cancer, we profiled 13369 single cells from 8 ovarian cancer samples, including 4 primary tumors, 2 peritoneal metastasis and 2 relapse tumors by single cell RNA-seq.

summary: Bronchial Epithelial cells were exposed to microparticles generated from mycobacterium abscessus MAB cell wall per an in-house protocol. Control group was exposed to saline. Differentially expressed genes related to MAB cell wall particles were determined.

title: miR-22 promotes stem cell traits via activating WNT/β-catenin signaling in cSCC
summary: Purpose: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) has revolutionized system-based cell pathway analysis. The purposes of this study were to compare and analyze the expression differences of skin squamous cell line A431 in stem cells after Mir-22 deletion. Methods: mRNA profiles of  control and case cells were generated by deep sequencing, in duplicate, using Illumina NovaSeq 6000. The sequence reads that passed quality filters were analyzed at the transcript isoform level with two methods:Bowtie2 to map clean reads to reference gene and use HISAT to reference genome.Bowtie2 parameters forSE reads:-q--phred64--sensitive--dpad0--gbar and HISTAparameters forSE reads:-p8--phred64--sensitive-I1-X 1000. qRT–PCR validation was performed using SYBR Green assays Results: Using an optimized data analysis workflow, we mapped about 24 million sequence reads per sample to the human genome (build hg19) and identified 17000 transcripts in control and case cells with RSEM workflow.  Approximately 5% of the transcripts showed differential expression between  control and case cells, with a fold change ≥1.5 and p value <0.01. Altered expression of 10 candidate genes was confirmed with qRT–PCR, demonstrating the high degree of sensitivity of the RNA-seq method.

title: Transcription analysis from the human embryonic kidney 293 cells (HEK293) were pre-treated with JIB-04, and then uninfected and infected with porcine rotavirus (PoRV)
summary: Purpose: Investigation of whole genome gene expression level changes in HEK293 cells response to JIB-04 and porcine rotavirus (PoRV)
design: Methods: HEK293A cells were pre-treated with JIB-04 (10 μM) for 12 hr, and then uninfected or infected with porcine rotavirus (PoRV) (MOI=0.01) for the 12 hpi. Total RNA from cells in duplicate was extracted using RNeasy Mini kit (Qiagen) according to manufacturer’s guidelines. RNA sample quality was measured by both NanoDrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent). Libraries were sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 platform. Then, differential gene expression analysis was performed using DESeq2.
