title: The oxidoreductase CLIC4 is required to maintain mitochondrial function and resistance to exogenous oxidants in breast cancer cells.
summary: We report the different transcriptom of 6DT1 (murine mammary cancer cell line) wildtype cells or CLIC4-KO (by CRISPR cas9) untreated or treated 1uM H2O2 for 24 hours.
design: 6DT1 transduced with lentivirus to express CLIC4 (lenti) or with lentivirus to express an empty vector (empty) cells were untreated or treated with 1uM H2O2 for 24 hours.

title: Transcriptomes of miR-290-295 KO mESCs treated with siPOOLs for three different transcription factors and a negative control
summary: In order to identify direct microRNA targets in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), we generated miR-290-295 KO mutant cell lines, assessed their transcriptomes. We identified novel transcription factors (TF) as potential direct and functional targets of miR-290-295. To assess the role of these TFs, we rescued their expression in the miR-290-295 KO cell line using siPOOLs and profiled their transcriptomes.

title: Transcriptome of miR-290-295 KO mESCs
summary: In order to identify direct microRNA targets in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), we knocked out microRNA effector genes, profiled their transcriptomes and integrated the data with additional published OMICs data sets. To validate the analysis, we generated miR-290-295 KO mutant cell lines, assessed the transcriptome profile and compared the observed misregulation to the predictions of the analysis.

title: Transcriptomics of AML12 transfected with PAV-TBG-P2A-GFP-Chrna4 over-expression plasmid
summary: We reported the transcriptomics responses from RNA-seq of AML12 transfected with Chrna4 over-expression plasmid. We used cultured AML12  from 3 to 5 generations and transfected it with pCMV6-AC-GFP or PAV-TBG-P2A-GFP-Chrna4 plasmid. After 24 h, total RNA of cultured AML12 was extracted with RNAiso Plus (TaKaRa). Then we delegated it to Novogene company for RNAseq aiming to identify key factors promoting this transition.

title: Transcriptional changes thymic lymphomas with overexpression of mutant MYC
summary: The goal of this study was to determine gene expression changes in thymic lymphomas with overexpression of mutant MYC
design: 12 samples were analyzed. Three reps were from control tissue. Three reps each for thymic lymphoma from MYCT58A and MYCS62A, and three reps for thymic mass from MYCS62A splenomegaly.

summary: Cancer infiltrating fibroablas from 4T1 cells pretreated with DMSO or GSKi (5 μM of GSK269962A (Axon, 1167)) for five days

title: RNA sequencing of RAI16 KO vs WT NIH3T3 cells
summary: RAI16 deficiency could protect cells against cell death induced by serum starvation. Furthermore, it was found that cell adhesion was enhanced in NIH3T3 RAI16 KO cells under serum starvation. RAI16 deficiency could protect cells against cell death induced by serum starvation. Furthermore, it was found that cell adhesion was enhanced in NIH3T3 RAI16 KO cells under serum starvation.

title: RNA-Seq of murine NIH/3T3 cells upon Aldoa knockdown
summary: Aldoa knockdown (using a pool of 4 siRNAs) vs. non-targeting control knockdown (using a pool of 4 siRNAs) in murine NIH/3T3 cells (fibroblasts). Cells were harvested 48 hours after transfection.

title: Vascular integrity is essential for maintaining tissue homeostasis
summary: Purpose: analyze the transcriptomic differences in PBS and Riociguat treated whole lung lysate Methods: C57BL6 mice were given PBS or Riociguat treatment (i.g.). 24h later, homogenize lung and extract mRNA Results: Riociguat has merely effect on normal mice lung

title: RNA sequencing of liver and kidney tissues from mice treated with rapamycin during development
summary: RNA sequencing of mouse liver and kidney. UMHET pups were treated with diet containing encapsulated rapamycin or encapsulating material as a control from birth to 45 days of age, and tissues were collected at 2, 20-22 and 27-29 months of age from both males and females, and 3-5 samples per age, sex and treatment were sequenced.
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for mice treated with rapamycin or control diet during postnatal development.

title: RNA seq analysis on immune cells isolated from nGD mice brain
summary: We observed significant changes in gene expression between Wt and nGD brain. nGD brains are highly enriched for immune infiltrates, both microglia and immune infiltrates are activated in nGD brains. Through scRNA seq we identified that, microglia specific Gba deletion lead to higher activation and expression of DAM signature genes compared to control mice.

title: Transcriptional response to vanoxerine in vivo treatments in MC38 colorectal tumors
summary: Murine colorectal cancer MC38 cells were injected in the flank of C57BL/6 mice to form tumor grafts over 7 days. Tumor-bearing mice were treated with daily injections of vanoxerine (25mg/kg) or vehichle control (saline) over 10 consecutive days. Tumors were excised and RNA sequencing profiling was performed on both experimental condition.

title: Transcriptome analysis of WT and lactoferrin knockout satellite cells grown for 4 days
summary: Our phenotypic data suggest that lactoferrin knockdown reduces satellite cell proliferative capacity. The mouse muscle tissue was digested with collagenase, and satellite cells were obtained by flow sorting. We performed transcriptome analysis of wt and lactoferrin knockout cells grown for 4 days in vitro.

title: Synthetic Essentiality of Tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase 2 in APC-Mutated Colorectal Cancer I
summary: We examined the pathways that are regulated by TDO2 in APC-deficient cancer cells by analyzing gene expression profiles of APC-WT and APC-KO MC38 cells that are transduced with inducible shTDO2 constructs. This study establishs that the TDO2-Kyn-AhR axis serves a critical role in promoting APC-deficient tumor growth via cancer cell autonomous (metabolism and proliferation) and non-autonomous mechanisms (tumor immunity).
design: Transcriptomic analysis of APC-intact and APC-deleted MC38 cell lines after inducible knockdown of TDO2.

title: Androgens Alleviate Allergic Airway Inflammation by Suppressing Cytokine Production of Th2 Cells
summary: This study reveraled that androgen signaling suppresses differentiation and cytokine production of Th2 cells by inducing DUSP-2, explaining, in part, the sex bias of asthma after adolescence.
design: Transcriptional profiling of Th2 differentiated cells with DHT from AR-flox/y (WT) and CD4-Cre; AR-flox/y mice

title: Chronic exposure to waterpipe smoke elicits immunomodulatory and carcinogenic effects in the lung II
summary: Previous reports showed that cigarette smoke elicits various molecular and immune changes in the lung. Very little is known of the effects of the chronic consumption of other forms of tobacco, such as waterpipe smoke (WPS), on lung pathobiology. Here, we studied the effects of chronic exposure to WPS versus control air on lungs of tumor-prone mice by RNA-sequencing (RNA-Seq). We find that WPS elicits immunomodulatory changes in the lung that are pertinent to carcinogenesis.

title: Transcriptional profiling identifies white matter changes in eNOS+/- mice I
summary: To elucidate the effects of eNOS deficiency at the transcriptional level, we performed RNA-seq on white matter and grey matter regions dissected from the brains of eNOS+/+ and eNOS+/- mice
design: RNA seq was done on the White matter and grey matter regions dissected from the brains of eNOS+/+ and eNOS+/- mice

title: Transcriptional profiling identifies white matter changes in eNOS+/- mice II
summary: To elucidate the effects of Sodium nitrate feeding eNOS deficiency at the transcriptional level, RNA-seq was performed on white matter region dissected from the brains of eNOS+/+ and eNOS-/- and eNOS -/- + Sodium Nitrate treatment

title: The impact of inflammation-induced tumor plasticity during myeloid transformation
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of mouse bone marrow immune populations isolated from Tet2 HR mutant and Tet2 Wildtype mice.

title: Pd1 regulates proliferation and differentiation of neural progenitors during brain development
summary: To gain a total insight into how Pd1 regulates embryonic neurogenesis, RNA-seq was performed to compare the different expressed genes ar E13. Approximately approximately one thousand transcripts showed differential expression between the Pd1fl/fl and Pd1CKO mice brain cortex, with a fold change ≥1.5 and p value <0.05. These results indicated the importance of Pd1 in cortical development. RNA-seq based transcriptome characterization would provide a global understanding how Pd1 gene contribute to brain cortical development.

title: Il-1-dependent enteric gliosis guides intestinal inflammation and dysmotility and modulates macrophage function
summary: IL-1 signaling in enteric glia initiates acute intestinal inflamation and modulates postoperative motility disturbances by triggering a reactive glial phenotype named enteric gliosis. Enteric glia modulate macrophage function and activity in this reactive state by releasing a unique panel of chemokines and cytokines. An enteric glia-selective knockout of this pathway ameliorates acute postoperative inflammation and prevents postoperative ileus.
design: Examination of enteric glial cells after IL-1b treatment in vitro and the effect of conditioned medium on BMDMs from IL1R1-KO animals

title: Ribotag-based Next Generation Sequencing of tumor-associated astrocytes
summary: GfapCRE:Rpl22HA mice were intracranially implanted with GL261 glioma cells (GBM) or injected with PBS (sham). Seventeen days later, RNA was retrieved from mouse brain extract (input) by anti-HA immunoprecipitation

title: Quantitative Analysis of Wild Type and Crtc2 adipocyte-specific KO Epididymal primary adipocyte Transcriptomes
summary: We attempted to analyze the effect of adipocyte-specific knockout of Crtc2 in in aging. By analyzing the transcriptomics of epididymal primary adipocytes from male mice with wild type and adipocyte-specific Crtc2 knockout mice in response to aging, we provide the insight into the collective roles of Crtc2 in epididymal white adipose tissues upon aging.

title: Effect of tubular IKKb deletion in acute ischemic kidney injury
summary: To establish the role of Ikkb during acute kidney injury, we use a mouse line with a specific deletion of Ikkb in the renal tubular system and exposed them to ischemia/reperfusion. Sample collection were done 2 days and 14 days after ischemia/reperfusion.
design: We then performed gene expression profiling analysis using data obtained from RNA-seq of control mice and tubular Ikkb-deletion mice at three time points (baseline, d2 and d14).

title: Integrated Analysis of lncRNA and mRNA Expression Profiles in brown adipose tissue of obesity-prone and obesity-resistant mice
summary: The expression profiles of lncRNAs in BAT were investigated by high-throughput RNA sequencing using HFD-induced C57BL/6J mice. Genes that play roles in thermogenesis and related pathways were identified.
design: The expression profiles of lncRNAs in BAT by high-throughput RNA sequencing using HFD-induced C57BL/6J mice.

title: Primary infection by E. multilocularis induces distinct patterns of crosstalk between hepatic Natural killer T and regulatory T cells in mice
summary: T cells are important in forming short- and long-term immunity. We used single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to assess their dynamics over the course of E. multilocularis infection.

title: scRNA-seq study of Eed-deleted cerebellar granule neuron progenitors (CGNPs)
summary: We studied CGNPs with conditional deletion of Eed using scRNA-seq. Eed was deleted in CGNPs by crossing Math1-Cre mice with Eed floxed mice. scRNA-seq seq was performed by Drop-seq. The results may be compared to our prior published data on scRNA-seq in normal CGNPs (GEO accession number GSE129730)

title: Transcriptome changes of liver from mice overexpressing Chrna4
summary: We injected adenovirus overexpressing Chrna4 as well as vehicle via tail vein (1× 10^9 pfu per mouse). Mice were fed with high-fat diet at the same time. After two weeks from virius injection, mice were sacrificed and samples were collected

title: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells integrate microbial signals to promote gut tissue repair
summary: This study examines how bone marrow (BM)-resident hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) are activated by bacterial insults for lineage specification to replenish the host hemato-immune system. We use the dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) colitis model to cause acute gut inflammation and observe molecular changes that occur in MPP2s, which expand both in the BM and MLN upon DSS treatment.

title: Identification of genes downregulated after Mettl3 knockdown under DNA damage conditions in E1A;HRasV12 expressing mouse embryonic fibroblasts
summary: The goal of the study was to identify those genes that are downregulated after Mettl3 knockdown under DNA-damage condition in oncogene-expressing mouse embryonic fibroblasts
design: We performed RNA-seq to identify those genes that are downregulated after Mettl3 knockdown under DNA-damage. We utilized oncogene-expressing fibroblasts expressing control shRNAs or shRNAs directed against Mettl3 to acutely knockdown Mettl3, and we treated cells for 6 hours with o,2 ug/ml of doxorubicin before performing RNA-seq.

title: Next generation sequencing analysis in Y-1 mouse adrenocortical cells after dexamethasone treatment
summary: RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was used to identify early transcriptomic responses of Y-1 cells to the  dexamethasone treatment.
design: Y-1 adrenocortical cells  were subcultured separately onto three groups. mRNA profiles of the control ,1h-dexamethasone treatment, and 24h-dexamethasone treatment were compared. Three replicated experiments were performed independently on different days starting from different cell passages.

title: Next generation sequencing analysis of mouse adrenal glands after a one-hour dexamethasone treatment
summary: RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was used to identify early transcriptomic responses of the adrenal gland to the 1-hour dexamethasone treatment in mice.

title: Development of an improved inhibitor of Lats Kinases to promote regeneration of mammalian organs
summary: To confirm that treatment with TDI‑011536 activates Yap in vivo, we collected liver and heart tissue for RNA sequencing four hours after IP injection at 200 mg/kg

title: Comparison of the Gr-1+ and Gr-1- monocyte gene expression in cell-type specific Fcgr2 deficiency on the Yaa backgound
summary: We generated 5 mouse lines:(1) Fcgr2 -/-.Yaa,(2)CD19Cre;Fcgr2 fl/fl.Yaa, (3)CEBPaCre;Fcgr2 fl/fl.Yaa, (4)CD11cCre;Fcgr2 fl/fl.Yaa, and (5)Fcgr2 fl/fl.Yaa. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from each mouse at 8 months old were collected and sorted by CD11b and Gr-1 cell surface markers. Sorted cells were subjected to RNA extraction and RNA-seq analysis

title: Nano-silica particles synergistically IgE-mediated mast cell activation
summary: To deeply investigate the details of the nano-SiO2 effects, we examined the gene expression profile alterations after nano-SiO2 treatment in BMMCs. The difference analysis between the groups showed that 285 genes were significantly expressed after treatment with nano-SiO2. Compared with the blank group, both nano-SiO2 exposure and DNP-HSA stimulation increased the expression of genes related to the MAPK signaling pathway in mast cells to varying degrees.

title: The central clock suffices to drive the majority of circulatory metabolic rhythms
summary: This dataset was generated to investigate the independence of the central clock in regulating hepatic transcriptional rhythms.
design: The core clock gene Bmal1 was knocked out using a floxed STOP codon (KO mice). By crossing these mice with Syt10-Cre mice we were able to rescue the Bmal1 expression in the suprachiasmatic nucleus (RE mice). These mice were compared with mice expressing Bmal1 in all tissues (WT). Livers were collected at 6 time points over the circadian 24-hour period.

title: Non-equilibrium pronucleus histones require gametal factor Lsm1 induced major satellite RNA decay
summary: The development of a multicellular organism with various organs and tissues is a complex but highly concerted process, in which cells acquire different identities through exquisite spatiotemporal regulations called cell fate decision. Here, we Lsm1 targets non-coding major satellite RNAs in mouse zygote, which is required for the non-equilibrium epigenetic modification, especially H3K9me3 establishment during early embryo development.

title: Transcriptomic analyses of the effects of hepatic insulin signaling on hepatic gene expression in the PiZ mouse model of alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency liver disease
summary: RNA-Seq data on livers from 4-5 month old male PiZ mice with or without genetic disruption of insulin receptor and FOXO1 hepatic expression
design: Analyses of WT, Z, and ZZ mice, WT v LIRKO v LIRKO-FOXO1-KO

title: Effect of 660-nm diode laser in the treatment of human breast epithelium by RNA sequencing
summary: Red light radiation has been proven to provide clinical benefits to human health. Our investigation was conducted to characterize tissue morphology of mouse breast post 660 nm-laser radiation with low power and long-term exposure.

title: RNA sequencing of short time IL-4 stimulated bone marrow derived cells with or without Elp3
summary: Comparison of transcriptome of 2 hours IL-4 treated bone marrow derived cells (BMDMs) from WT and Elp3 KO mice
design: Bone marrow cells were isolated from Wildtype mice and myeloid Elp3 deficient mice, then the cells were cultured in L929 medium and treated or not by IL4 for 2 hours.

title: Loss of hepatic DRP1 exacerbates alcoholic hepatitis by inducing megamitochondria and mitochondrial maladaptation
summary: To investigate the function of mitochondrial fission protein DRP1 in the development of alcoholic liver disease, we generated liver-specific Dnm1l KO mice using Alb-Cre/loxP system. These mice were subjected to Gao-Binge alcohol model. We then performed RNA sequensing analysis using the liver tissue. Gene expression profiling analysis was conducted using data obtained from RNA-seq of 4 different groups.
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for L-DRP1 KO and its WT mice in both control and ethanol feeding conditions.

title: In vitro generation of brain regulatory T cells by co-culturing with astrocytes
summary: We developed a culture method that confers brain Treg characteristics in vitro. Naive Tregs from the spleen were activated and efficiently amplified by T-cell receptor (TCR) stimulation in the presence of primary astrocytes.

title: Gene expression analysis in Tyk2 deficient AOM/DSS colorectal tumors in mice
summary: The goal of this study was to determine differences in gene expression profiles in colonic tumors of AOM/DSS treated mice with a total (Tyk2KO) or conditional deletion of Tyk2 in the intestinal epithelium (Tyk2DIEC).

title: RNA-seq of Tnpo3fl/fl pro-B cells
summary: Gene expression analysis in Tnpo3fl/fl mb1Cre compared to Tnpo3+/+ mb1Cre pro-B cells.

title: Effect of IL-1a-deficiency on neutrophil gene expression during P. aeruginosa infection of the corneas
summary: We found enhanced bacterial killing and less disease in Il1a-/- corneas compared to WT when infected with PAO1. To investigate the mechanism downstream of IL-1R1, we compared the transcriptomic profile of neutrophils isolated from WT or Il1a-/- infected corneas.
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for WT and Il1a-/- neutrophils FACS isolated from PAO1-infected corneas at 24 hours post infection.

title: Mitochondria-targeted partial inhibiton of complex I increase health and lifespan in aged male and female mice.
summary: We performed next-generation RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) using brain and fat tissue from 26 months old vehicle and CP2-treated (wild-type) WT mice.
design: mRNA profiles of 26 months old Veh-treated and CP2 (mitochondrial complex I  inhibitor)-treated WT mice were generated by deep sequencing, using Illumina HiSeq 4000 with paired end 101-bp read length.

title: Liver RNA sequencing data from wildtype and DKO mice during dietary leucine deprivation or control feeding
summary: The goal of this project is to perform a systemic analysis of transcriptional responses in the liver of WT and Sestrin DKO mice during dietary leucine deprivation.

title: PHARMACOLOGICAL INHIBITION AND REVERSAL OF PANCREATIC ACINAR DUCTAL METAPLASIA
summary: Acinar ductal metaplasia (ADM), is believed to be one of the earliest precursor lesions towards the development of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and maintaining the pancreatic acinar cell phenotype suppresses tumor formation. We report that pStat3 and HDAC inhibition can attenuate ADM in vitro and TSA treatment reverses the dedifferentiated phenotype to one that is more acinar. Our findings suggest that pharmacological inhibition or reversal of pancreatic ADM represents a potential therapeutic strategy for blocking ductal reprogramming of acinar cells.
design: Following KC mouse acini undergoing ADM for 2 days, 500 nM of TSA or LLL12B was added to the cultures for an additional 2 days. Cells from the LLL12B, TSA, or day 4 untreated controls cells in triplicate were subjected to whole transcriptome sequencing.

title: The impact of Prdm16 deletion on the transcriptome of the developing cochlear duct cells
summary: The PR domain containing 16 (PRDM16) is a key transcription regulator in the development of craniofacial, adipose, neural, and hematopoietic tissues. Our lab identified PRDM16 expression in the epithelial cells of the Kölliker’s organ (KO) starting around E13.5 and maintained until the disappearance of the KO around P10. Bulk RNA sequencing of cochlear duct cells at E14.5 followed by quantitative real time PCR and mRNA Fluorescence in-situ hybridization identified differentially expressed genes in Prdm16-null versus littermate control cochleae.
design: Cochlear duct mRNA profiles of embryonic day 14.5 (E14.5) wild type (WT), Prdm16-het and Prdm16-null mice

title: Bulk RNA-sequencing in Ldlr-/- or Ch25h-/-;Ldlr-/- peritoneal macrophages treated with LPS
summary: Here we study the effect of LPS in the transcriptome of thioglycollate-elicited peritoneal macrophages isolated from Ldlr knock out and Ch25h;Ldlr double knock out mice
design: mRNA profiles from thioglycollated-elicited peritoneal macrophages isoaltes from LDLR KO CH25H;LDLR DKO mice

title: SMNDC1 links chromatin remodeling and splicing to regulate pancreatic hormone expression [BSA_0275_SMNDC1]
summary: We have found that loss of SMNDC1 (Survival Motor Neuron Domain Containing 1), a component of the spliceosome complex, in both murine alpha cells and human islets is capable of inducing an overall increase in beta cell markers and activating insulin transcription.

title: Transcriptomics of trophoblast stem cells and extraembryonic endoderm stem cells
summary: To identify splicing regulators with unique regulation in placenta and the trophectoderm lineage, we sequenced trophoblast stem (TS) and Extraembryonic endoderm stem (XEN) cells.

title: 3' sequencing of placenta form Mbnl2 and Mbnl3 KOs
summary: To investigate the impact of Mbnl2 and Mbnl3 in placenta development and function through the regulation of alternative poly-adenylation, we have generated 3'-seq data from placenta from single and double KO mice at different developmental stages.

title: Placenta transcriptomics of Mbnl2 and Mbnl3 KOs (RNA-seq)
summary: To investigate the impact of Mbnl2 and Mbnl3 in placenta development and function, we have generated RNA-seq data from placenta from single and double KO mice at different developmental stages.

title: Loss of Cdx2 drives direct trophoblast differentiation into trophoblast giant cells via TFAP2C (RNA-Seq)
summary: In this experiment, the effect of reduced CDX2 expression on the trophoblast stem cells (TSCs) transcriptome was assayed.
design: Transcriptional profiles were generated from three independent biological replicates in four experimental conditions. shRNA vectors containing a constitutively active mCherry cassette to visualise and isolate transfected and non-transfected populations. Positively transfected CDX2 knockdown TSCs were compared with control transfected and untransfected TSC populations.

title: ISR pathway activation signatures in MEFs: GCN2 and PERK
summary: In response to different cellular stressors, the ISR kinases, PERK, PKR, HRI and GCN2, activate downstream transcriptional programs. While the core ISR transcription program is well characterized, markers that are specific to each individual ISR kinase activation pathway are not known. To identify markers that are induced by PERK or GCN2, but not the other ISR kinases, we subjected WT, GCN2-/-, and PERK-/- MEFs to amino acid starvation (RPMI 1640 SILAC -Lys -Arg) or Thapsigargin (200nM) treatment for 6 hours to activate the GCN2 and PERK pathways, respectively and performed RNA sequencing.
design: To identify markers that are induced by PERK or GCN2, but not the other ISR kinases, we subjected WT, GCN2-/-, and PERK-/- MEFs to amino acid starvation for 6 hours to activate the GCN2 and PERK pathways, respectively and performed RNA sequencing and differential analysis.

title: Differentially expressed genes in B-1b compared to B-1a
summary: B-1b cells are known to produce higher IgM level compared to B-1a cells. This study aims to identify differentially expressed genes and pathways that might enrich in B-1b cells and contribute to higher IgM production.

title: Next generation sequence of RNA in hematoma basal ganglia tissue of ICH mice model
summary: To study the regulation of neuroinflammatory genes following an ICH insult, we induced ICH in C57 mice and analyzed the mRNA expression profile in the brain by RNA seq

title: Bulk RNA sequencing of Vegfr3 fl/fl (Ctrl) and Vegfr3 fl/fl;prox1creERT2 (Vegfr3iLKCko) mouse conjunctival tissue with or without allergic eye disease
summary: To systematically evaluate the role of pro-lymphangiogenic VEGFR3 signal in allergic eye disease we performed RNAseq analysis of unchallenged Ctrl (without allergic eye disease), OVA-challenged Ctrl (with allergic eye disease) and OVA-challenged Vegfr3iLECko (with allergic eye disease) mouse conjunctiva

title: SREBP signaling is essential for effective B cell responses and memory formation
summary: To investigate the function of SREBP signaling in established germinal center B cells, we generated SCAP fl/fl AID-Cre-YFP mice. We then performed gene expression profiling analysis using data obtained from RNA-seq of sorted germinal center B cells from immunized control and SCAP fl/fl AID-Cre-YFP mice
design: Comparison of gene expression of control vs KO drainging lymph node germinal center B cells isolated 14 days post subcutaneous NP-OVA+RIBI immunization.

title: The effects of SCAP deletion on gene expression of activated B cells
summary: To investigate the role of SREBP signaling in B cell activation, we stimulated SCAP+/+CD19Cre/+ (WT) and SCAPfl/fl CD19Cre/+ (KO) B cells with LPS, anti-CD40 or anti-IgM for 24 hrs and performed RNA sequencing to identifiy the differences.

title: Transcriptomic analysis of wild-type microglia isolated from fluorescent reporter mice
summary: Microglia isolated from tamoxifen-inducible Cx3cr1 cre mice harboring expression of a ZsGreen transgene in the ROSA26 locus were analyzed by RNA-sequencing. The purpose of this dataset is to serve as experimental controls as part of broader analyses of microglial-mediated neuroprotection during CNS infection with Toxoplasma gondii.

title: Microglial STAT1-sufficiency is required for resistance to toxoplasmic encephalitis
summary: RNA-seq experiment examining the transcriptional profiles of FACS-sorted wild-type and STAT1-deficient microglia isolated from mice infected with the Me49 strain of T. gondii.
design: Differential gene expression analysis of FACS-sorted brain-resident wild-type or STAT1-deficient microglia from mice challenged with T. gondii and analyzed at 12 days post-infection.

title: Next generation sequence analysis of cells derived from mouse hair follicles after long term culture
summary: Follicle epithelial stem cells (HFSCs) have important functions for homeostasis of skin as well as hair follicle morphogenesis. In the present study, we screened different types of commercially available culture medium for culturing HFSCs. Among those tested, one type was shown capable of supporting the expression of stem cell markers in cultured HFSCs. However, the differentiation ability of HFSCs serially passaged using that optimal medium was found to be impaired, leading to unsuccessful formation of hair follicles in vivo.

title: Reprograming responsiveness of tolerogenic CD8+ T cells using a CXCR4 antagonist-armed oncolytic virus requires reversal of M2 macrophage polarization
summary: Overcoming barriers to the generation of antitumor immunity to self-and neo-antigens is a central concern of cancer immunotherapy. This study investigated the effect of interactions between ovarian cancer (OC) cells and the tumor microenvironment (TME) on the ability of oncolytic virotherapy to activate responsiveness of self antigen-specific and neoantigen-specific CD8+ T lymphocytes in tolerogenic and wild-type (WT) murine tumor models, respectively

title: RNA-seq analysis after overexpression of miR-148a in keratinocytes
summary: Identification of the trasncriptional changes linked to over expression of miR-148a in kerratinocytes
design: Control and overexpression of miR-148a (pro-miR-148a) in primary mouse epidermal keratinocytes

title: Transcriptional profiling of short term intestinal tissue in mice with Apc and Kras mutations
summary: Murine small intestinal tissue following Apc mutation, with or without Kras mutation under the control of VilCreER.
design: Expression data from whole intestinal tissue of the noted genotypes.

title: Hoxb5 reprograms murine multipotent blood progenitors into hematopoietic stem cell-like cells
summary: We performed the single cell RNA-seq for the Hoxb5 Mac-1+CD48+ SK cells, bone marrow HSC, bone marrow MPP, and fetal liver HSC by Smart-Seq2.

title: Pancreas agenesis mutations disrupt a lead enhancer controlling a developmental enhancer cluster
summary: Single cell RNA-Seq and ATAC-Seq in mouse E10.5 multipotent pancreatic progenitors (MPCs) and single cell ATAC-Seq of mouse E13.5 pancreas.

title: Dynamic profiling of histone Kcr and Kla during neural differentiation in vivo
summary: To gain a deeper insight into dynamic changes of histone lysine crotonylation and lactylation during embryonic neurogenesis, ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq and RNA-seq were performed to analyze the genome-wide changes of histone Kcr and Kla in the developing telencephalon.

title: Analysis of transcriptome in mouse tissue following Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis infection
summary: Purpose : Comparative analysis of host transcriptomes according to infection route following MAP infection  Methods : Mice were infected with MAP by oral/intraperitoneal (IP) route. Total RNA were harvested from spleen and mesenteric lymph node after 6 weeks. RNA-seq was performed with total RNA of each sample.  Results : Canonical pathway analysis showed that LXR/RXR activation pathway had negative z-score in IP group, whereas positive in oral group.

title: Bulk transcriptomic comparison between in vitro propagated DNGR-1-lineage traced cells and hippocampus derived neural stem cells
summary: We compared by bulk RNA sequencing the transcriptomic profile of in vitro cultured DNGR-1-traced neural stem cells or their differentiated astrocytic progeny with similar cell fates generated from bonafide neural stem cells derived from the hippocampus.

title: TWIST1 is required for HSC maintenance under steady state and stress condition by inhibiting mitochondrial metabolism gene program
summary: RNA-seq and ATAC-seq were performed to determine possible downstream molecular mechamisms and the changes in chromatin accessibility in long-term hematopoietic stem cell when TWIST1 was absent following irradiation stress. We found that mitochondrial metabolism pathway was strongly turned on in the Twist1-deficient LT-HSCs upon irradiation stress.

title: Analysis of Wild Type and Siah2 KO time series liver transcriptome from male and female mice [ZT 10]
summary: Female-specific role of Siah2 in regulating circadian gene expression in the liver

title: Analysis of Wild Type and Siah2 KO time series liver transcriptome from male and female mice [ZT0-ZT21]
summary: Female-specific role of Siah2 in regulating circadian gene expression in the liver

title: β-cell-specific deletion of Zfp148 improves nutrient-stimulated β-cell Ca2+ responses
summary: Insulin secretion from pancreatic β-cells is essential for glucose homeostasis. An insufficient response to the demand for insulin results in diabetes. We previously showed that β-cell-specific deletion of Zfp148 (β-Zfp148KO) improves glucose tolerance and insulin secretion in mice. These RNA sequencing data show pathways altered in the β-Zfp148KO consistent with altered PEP cycling and improved insulin secretion responses.

title: Transcriptional responses in SIX2 nephron progenitor cells following mitochondrial complex III subunit 7 (Qpc) inactivation
summary: To identify novel transcriptional targets following Qpc inactivation. We deleteted Qpc in SIX2 nephron progenitor cells using a Six2-eGFP/cre BAC transgene. We compared SIX2-expressing progenitors from Six2-Qpc-/- kidneys with control (Six2-Qpc+/-) embryonic kidneys at E18.5.
design: 4 control samples were compared with 5 mutant samples

title: The Transcription Factor ThPOK Regulates ILC3 Lineage Homeostasis and Function during Intestinal Infection II
summary: To investigate the role of ThPOK in the regulation of ILC3 development and function, we established conventional ThPOK knockout mice and carried out single-cell RNA sequencing  (BD Rhapsody) on intestinal ILC3s.

title: TFH and TFR cells with different timing of peanut sensitizations
summary: Peanut-specific IgE is present with peanut sensitizations at day 1 an day 8, while is absent with peanut sensitizations at day 1 and day 3. Since TFH and TFR cells are import in regulating antibody response in germinal center, we would like to know the different in TFH and TFR cells between D1D3 and D1D8 peanut sensitizations.

title: Transcriptome of cytokines-polarized mouse bone marrow-derived macrophages
summary: To understand the molecular signature of the IL-10/IL-18 polarized macrophages, we performed transcriptome analysis for mouse BMDMs polarized with PBS (Naïve), IFN-γ (classic M1 stimulator, M1, 20ng/ml), IL-4 (alternative M2 stimulator, M2, 20ng/ml), IL-10 (M10, 2000ng/ml), IL-18 (M18, 2000ng/ml) or IL-10 and IL-18 (M1018, 2000ng/ml each). These data suggest that IL-10 and IL-18 cooperatively modulate a set of gene expressions and pathway activities in macrophages and contribute to a distinct polarization state.
design: Transcriptome of mouse bone marrow-derived macrophages polarized with six different groups of cytokines.

title: Hyperactivation of Necdin, a new biomarker for Cockayne syndrome neurological disease
summary: To investigate the cooperative roles of CSB and NDN interaction in the regulation of neural function in vivo, we generated AAV constructs for the expression of shRNA-CSB or shRNA-NDN. We then delivered these viruses into the bilateral V1 region of mice cortex in which each target gene has been knocked down.

title: Splice Factor Polypyrimidine tract-binding protein 1 (Ptbp1) Primes Endothelial Inflammation in Atherogenic Disturbed Flow Conditions [Ptbp1]
summary: Analysis of effects of Ptbp1 deletion on RNA splicing and expression in aortic endothelial cells

title: IL-33 function on CD4-CD8- double negative T cells in vitro
summary: Methods: RNA transcription profiling of double negative T cells was compared between control group and IL-33 treated group

title: Understanding how IL-2 cytokine synergizes with PD-1 directed immunotherapy during chronic viral infection [RNA-seq]
summary: This work aimed to understand how different IL2 varients

title: Understanding how IL-2 cytokine synergizes with PD-1 directed immunotherapy during chronic viral infection [Bulk RNA-seq]
summary: This work aimed to understand how different IL2 varients

title: Identification of a shared disease-associated oligodendrocyte signature among multiple CNS pathologies
summary: The role of oligodendrocytes in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) has never been fully elucidated. To dissect their possible contribution to the disease we perform single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) on the brains of healthy and 5XFaD (genetic model of AD) at different ages.

title: Maternal Smchd1 regulates Hox gene expression and patterning in the mouse embryo [RNAseq tailbud]
summary: RNAseq from somite-matched tailbud tissue from E8-8.5 embryo tailbuds at the 6-11 somite developmental stages
design: Our overall design is to compare between Smchd1 control and Smchd1 maternally deleted samples. We have performed RNA-seq in 37 tailbud samples from E8-8.5 mouse embryos, with 6 to 11 somites each.  In all cases we compare the Smchd1 maternally deleted to the control, at the matched somite number.

title: iTag labelling of Liver, Plasma and VsWAT RNA
summary: Using a novel method for metabolic labelling of RNA called iTag RNA we isolate hepatocytes' and kidney proximal epithelial cells' transcriptional response to a dietary challenge and identify multiple hepatocyte-secreted small ccfRNAs in plasma, and transfer of these hepatic derived ccfRNAs to VsWAT
design: mRNA /small RNA sequencing from liver plasma and kidney of male 12 week old mice following 2w of high fat diet feeding or low fat diet control

title: Single-cell gene expression reveals the stage-specific roles of TCF1 in T cell development and T cell malignancy
summary: T cell factor 1 (TCF1; encoded by Tcf7) plays a critical role in T cell development and functions as a tumor suppressor by repressing the expression of LEF1 in the thymus. Here we reported the stage-specific regulation of TCF1 in early T cell differentiation and T cell malignancy despite the broad understand on the functions of TCF1. To illustrate the stage-specific functions of Tcf7 in T cell development and tumorigenesis, we applied single-cell transcriptional analysis to identify the precise trajectory of gene expression changes between the surface receptor-defined stages of T cell development.
design: To systematically investigate the gene expression pattern in WT and stage-specific deletion of Tcf7, we sequenced 768 single cells from four genotype mice (WT, Tcf7-/-, Tcf7fl/flVav-cre, Tcf7fl/flLck-cre). The cell type of WT is DN1 (96 single cell) and DN2-3 (96 single cell). The cell type of Tcf7-/- is DN1 (96 single cell) and DN2-3 (96 single cell). The cell type of Tcf7fl/flVav-cre is DN1 (96 single cell) and DN2-3 (96 single cell). The cell type of Tcf7fl/flLck-cre is DN2-3 (192 single cell).

title: VISTA targeting of T cell quiescence and myeloid suppression overcomes adaptive resistance
summary: VISTA is a premier target for cancer treatment due to its broad expression in many cancer types and enhanced expression upon development of adaptive immune checkpoint resistance. Mechanisms of enhanced anti-tumor immunity were investigated using scRNAseq of the tumor immune infiltrate.

title: Role of ILC in bladder infection
summary: The effect of ILCs on UTI was compared in Rag mice within the bladder

title: IL22RKO bladders following UTI
summary: WT or IL22RKO mice recived a UTI and bladders were collected for RNAseq
design: WT uninfected or infected bladders and IL22RKO infected bladders

title: RNA sequencing of Rictor-deficient epidermis
summary: We sequenced mRNA from control and Rictor -/- epidermis at E19.5, 3 biological replicates each.

title: Long-term exposure to PM2.5 aggravates pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury by disrupting Nrf2-mediated antioxidant function
summary: To investigate the difference damage patterns bewteen short-term and long-term exposure to PM2.5 particulate matter
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for mice exposed to PM2.5 particulate matter

title: Tissue-resident CXCR4+ macrophage as a poor prognosis signature promotes pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression
summary: In this study, we explored the CXCR4+ macrophages subset on its prognosis value, immune profile and distinct function in pancreatic cancer progression. RNA-seq analysis is performed to find the distinct characters of mouse tumor-derived Cxcr4+ macrophages.

title: Direct conversion of rod to cone-like photoreceptors by NRL knockdown with cell-penetrating siRNA
summary: To investigate the retinal transcriptome in which Nrl gene is  knocked down by cp-asiRNA (cp-asiNRL) in wildtype C57BL/6J mouse and laser-induced CNV model.
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for wildtype C57BL/6J mouse and laser-induced CNV model mouse when PBS or cp-asiRNA targeting Nrl were treated.

title: Characterization of postnatal mouse adrenal chromaffin cells
summary: Chromaffin cells were selected from dissociated postnatal mouse adrenals by immunopanning using L1CAM, expanded in sphere cultures and analyzed by RNA sequencing

title: Single cell transcriptome analysis of non-neuronal cell populations in mouse brain cortex
summary: Single cell RNA-Seq analysis for myelin-depleted brain cortex cell populations of juvenile, adult, aged and Experimental Autoimmune Encephalomyelitis (EAE) mice

title: Single cell preparations of Mycobacterium tuberculosis damage the mycobacterial envelope and disrupt macrophage interactions
summary: In order to investigate the impact of using in vitro techniques to generate single cell suspensions of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) on macrophage gene expression, we compared uninfected bone marrow derived macrophages to macrophages infected with Mtb that was prepared using gentle sonication followed by low-speed centrifugation (so/sp)  or passage through a 5 µm syringe filter (5µmF).
design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for wild-type murine macrophages were uninfected or infected with Mtb H37Rv at a multiplicity of infection of 5 followed by RNA sequencing at 72 hours post infection. 5 experimental replicates were performed for each group.

title: Analysis of the repressive activity of RBPJ in a mature T cell line
summary: The Notch signaling pathway regulates gene expression via the transcription factor RBPJ. Here we investigated the the repressive role of RBPJ in a mature T cell line by combining RNA-Seq, ChIP-Seq and ATAC-Seq data under several different conditions.

title: m6A modification involves in enriched environment-induced neurogenesis and cognition enhancement
summary: Our results suggest that different environment induces differential m6A mRNA modification, and add novel layer of the interaction between environment and epigenetics during the postnatal neuronal development.

title: Transcriptome analysis of nascent hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) induced by the ectopic expression of Evi1
summary: To examine the role of Evi1 in HSC specification, we generated Tie2-Cre::ROSA-Evi1 mice, which can induce Evi1 in endothelial cells. We observed five-fold increase of HSCs In Tie2-Cre::ROSA-Evi1 embryo. To characterize the induced HSCs in Tie2-Cre::ROSA-Evi1 embryos, we analyzed the gene expression profile of HSCs.
design: HSCs were isolated from Tie2-Cre::ROSA-Evi1 and ROSA-Evi1 fetal livers, and were subjected to RNA-seq analysis.

title: Murine model and pathogenesis of radiation induced liver fibrosis.
summary: We have developed a new model of radiation-induced liver fibrosis and aimed to understand the underlying mechanism using RNAseq.

title: Transcriptome analysis of nascent hematopoietic cells II
summary: During ontogeny, HSCs or progenitors are generated from endothelial cells through the process known as endothelial-to-hematopoietic transition (EHT). After EHT, hematopoietic cells form cell aggregates, called hematopoietic clusters. To obtain mechanistic insight into HSC specification, we compared the gene expression profiles of hematopoietic clusters between caudal half region and yolk sac.

title: Modulating mitofusins to control mitochondrial function and signaling
summary: Purpose: Mitofusin regulate the fusion of the outer mitochondrial membrane. MASM7 is an activator of mitofusins, which promotes mitochondrial fusion. Whereas, MFI8 is an inhibitor of mitofusins, which inhibits mitochondrial fusion, and subsequently promotes mitochondrial fission. The goal of this study is to identify set of genes and pathways that are up-regulated  upon inhibition and activation of mitochondrial fusion.

title: Dysregulation of gene expression in SCGB3A2 Knock-out mouse
summary: Gene expression in lung tissues were evallulated in SCGB3A2 knock-out mice.

title: cAMP-MicroRNA-203-IFNγ Network Regulates Subcutaneous White Fat Browning and Glucose Tolerance
summary: To determine the function of miR-203 in white fat browning upon cold exposure, we injected miR-203 inhibitors and negative control into inguinal white adipose tissue, followed by cold exposure (4oC) for 24 hours. Total RNA were harvested for RNA-seq.

title: The effect of CNF1 on macrophage polarization
summary: Research on the mechanism of Cytotoxic Necrotizing Factor 1 in regulating macrophage polarization.To study the molecular mechanisms through which CNF1 induces M1 macrophage polarization, we analyzed gene expression profiles of BMDMs treated with CNF1 or dialysis buffer.

title: Transcriptional effects of YAP/TAZ knockout in primary mouse dermal fibroblasts
summary: We compared the transcriptomes of control and YAP/TAZ knockout fibroblasts, and the latter in the presence or absence of a STING inhibitor

title: Lack of electron acceptors contributes to redox stress and growth arrest in asparagine-starved sarcoma cells
summary: Adequate availability of the non-essential amino acid asparagine is necessary to support growth and survival of sarcoma cells. The three top pathways enriched among transcripts upregulated in asparagine-depleted cells included ribosome, aminoacyl tRNA biosynthesis and oxidative phosphorylation.

title: RNA profile in TRIM24-C52/55A knockin mouse liver
summary: RNA profiling was performed in the liver of TRIM24-C52/55A knockin mice fed the high fat diet to identify key downstream targets of TRIM24.

title: sham and MI heart transcriptome after 6-week-long light-phase intermittent prednisone or vehicle administration
summary: Exogenous glucocorticoids interact with the circadian clock, but little attention is paid to their time of intake. Here we investigated the transcriptional effects of prednisone in  heart when pulsed as intermittent once-weekly 1mg/kg i.p. dose in  WT mice at ZT0 at 2-weeks after sham or myocardial infarction (MI; permanent ligation) surgeries.  Aftter 6 weeks of treatment, we performed RNA-seq analysis in myocardial tissue to quantitate gene expression at isoform level.
design: 3 samples sham + vehicle; 3 samples sham + weekly prednisone; 3 samples MI +vehicle; 3 samples MI + weekly prednisone. Each sample was ~1ug RNA isolated through Trizol and further purifed through RNeasy columns.

title: Single-nuclei RNA-seq of the nucleus tractus solitarii and area postrema at for baseline and LPS-activated cell types
summary: To identify LPS activated cell types in the NTS and AP we region we used single-nuclei RNA seq comparing baseline cell types and cell types labeled using the TRAP2 mouse line crossed to the INTACT mouse line after labeling during LPS treatment.

title: Paracrine-Mediated Rejuvenation of Aged Mesenchymal Stem Cells
summary: To examine underlying differences in gene expression between young and old MSCs  and the effects of exposure of old MSCs to media conditioned by young MSCs on gene expression  we performed RNA sequencing

title: Remote ischemic preconditioning causes transient cell-cycle arrest and renal protection by a NF-kB-dependent Sema5B pathway
summary: Our study investigates how RIPC modulates the transcriptomic profile of neutrophils and renal tubular epithelial cells in the kidney during acute kidney injury.

title: A Novel Cytoskeletal Action of Xylosides
summary: To investigate the concentration-dependent effects of xylosides on morphology and gene expression of Neuro2A cells

title: Gene expression profile at the single cell level of vagal ganglia neurons from P4 mice
summary: Vagal neurons are an incredibly heterogeneous population of sensory neurons that are important for homeostasis. We used single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to interrogate their molecular diversity shortly after birth.

title: Effects of NSUN6 deficiency by systematic transcriptomes and m5C profiles in mice across tissue [RNA-Seq]
summary: we constructed Nsun6-KO mouse, and observed that the wight and appearance of KO mice didn’t show abnormality. Through Bisulfite sequencing (BS-seq) in wild-type (WT) as well as KO mice and mRNA-seq, we identified high confident Nsun6-dependent m5C sites and performed the transcriptome analysis across five tissues.

title: Thymic epithelial cells co-opt lineage-defining transcription factors to eliminate autoreactive T cells [RNA-seq]
summary: We profiled medullary thymic epithelial cell subsets and peripheral cell types by bulk RNA-seq to investigate mechanisms of T-cell tolerance.

title: Transcriptional impact of EGFR-AT1R-TP receptor crosstalk in mouse aortic vascular smooth muscle cells
summary: The impact EGFR, AT1R and TP receptor individual or simultaneous activations on the gene expression was investigated in mouse aortic vascular smooth muscle cells (aVSMC)

title: A gastruloid model of the interaction between embryonic and extra-embryonic cell types
summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing of extra-embryonic endoderm enhanced gastruloids (XEGs) and gastruloids

title: Embryologic Origin Influences Smooth Muscle Cell Phenotypic Modulation Signatures in Murine Marfan Syndrome Aortic Aneurysm
summary: Aortic single-cell RNA sequencing data from second heart field lineage traced mice with Fbn1C1041G/+ and control mice.

title: Effect of depletion of ANXA2 and ANXA5 on gene expression in primary murine mesenchymal stromal cells
summary: To investigate the effects of ANXA2 or ANXA5 depletion on gene expression in primary mesenchymal stromal cells we compared the gene expression profile of sorted mesenchymal stromal cells from the bone marrow of normal wildtype, ANXA2 knockout or ANXA5 knockout mice.

title: TRPV1 SUMOylation suppresses itch by inhibiting TRPV1 interaction with H1 receptors
summary: To examine the functional significance of TRPV1 SUMOylation in vivo, we created a TRPV1K823R KI transgenic mouse line.We thus performed gene expression profiling analysis using data obtained from RNA-seq of the trigeminal ganglion of TRPV1K823R and control mouse models . Our analyses unveiled a role for TRPV1 SUMOylation in regulating gene networks related to the pain and itch pathway.

title: UVB-induced skin autoinflammation due to NLRP1 mutation and its inhibition by anti-IL-1b antibody
summary: To analyze the pathogenic mechanism of the autoinflammatory skin syndromes caused by an NLRP1 mutation, we sought to generate Nlrp1b mutation knock-in mice mice as a mouse model of cutaneous autoinflammatory lesions due to NLRP1 mutants, and examine the expression of proteins, such as cytokines, and the mRNA expression profile, including inflammasome-related genes in the model lesions.

title: Transcriptome profiling of the ventral pallidum reveals a role for pallido-thalamic neurons in cocaine reward
summary: Using RNAseq, we evaluated transcriptomic changes in the ventral pallidum (VP) of mice 24h following 10 days of cocaine self-administration.

title: Bulk RNA sequencing of the interface tissue after mouse anterior-cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR)
summary: Transcriptomic profile of the myeloid cells infiltrated into the interface tissue after mouse ACLR surgery

title: Exercise promotes bone marrow microenvironment by inhibiting Adipsin in diet-induced obese mice
summary: To study how exercise induces bone remodeling in diet-induced obesity in a comprehensive way.8-week male C57/B6 mice were fed with HFD to establish an obese mice model. Then mice were randomly divided into 2 groups: the exercise and the control groups. The exercise group of mice was put on a moderate-intensity treadmill running for 12 weeks.We employed unbiased RNA-Seq to comprehensively investigate the exercise effect on the bone marrow of diet-induced obesity mice in vivo.

title: Transcriptomic analysis of mice heart following transverse aortic constriction (TAC) surgery
summary: We did TAC surgery for mice and daily treated the mice with Vehicle or SR9009
design: We harvest mice at around ZT10 and snap frozen the heart samples for transcrptomic analysis.

title: Next Generation Sequencing Facilitates Quantitative Analysis of Reverb fl/fl and  Reverb fl/fl /MHC+ cardiac Transcriptomes
summary: We use reverb heart specific ko mouse model to exclude the function of reverb in heart
design: We harvest mice at 6 ZTs and snap frozen the hear samples for transcrptomic analysis.

title: Effect of TGFb on TCR-induced OT-I T cell gene expression
summary: To investigate the impact of TGFb on CD8 T cell activation and gene expression, we activated TCR transgenic OT-I T cells in the presence or absence of recombinant TGFb in vitro
design: OT-I T cells were stimulated for 24h with SIITFEKL (T4) peptide in the presence or absence of TGFb and gene expression profiling analysis using RNA-Seq was performed

title: Effect of long non-coding RNA LL35/Falcor depletion on gene expression in murine hepatocytes in vivo and in vitro
summary: To determine and compare a functional role of long non-coding RNA LL35/Falcor in murine hepatocytes in vitro and in vivo we performed a transcriptome analysis of AML12 hepatocytes cell line and murine liver after LL35 depletion.
design: Differential gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for AML12 cells with depleted LL35 (AML12 LL35 ASO) in comparison with control (AML12 Luc ASO), and for murine liver (Liver LL35 ASO) in comparison with control (Liver Luc ASO).

title: Rif1 functions in complex with PRC1.6 to regulate mouse embryonic stem cells fate potential [RNA-seq]
summary: To investigate the cooperative function Rif1 and PRC1.6 complex in the regulation of embryonic development and cell differentiation, we selected embryonic stem cells in which each target gene has been knocked down by shRNA or knocked out  conditionally. We then performed gene expression profiling analysis using data obtained from RNA-seq of different samples.

title: RNAseq analysis of GM-CSF and M-CSF polarized bone marrow derived macrophages cultured on TC or noTC dishes
summary: Bone marrow cells were isolated, primed with M-CSF (M BMDM) or GM-CSF (GM BMDM) and cultured on tissue culture dishes (TC) or low adherent dishes (noTC) for 7 days. BMDMs were treated with LPS (100 ng/ml) for 3 hours. The difference between TC- and noTC-cultured BMDMs were analyzed to describe the phenotye and function of each population. Moreover, the influence of LPS treatment on GM-BMDMs and M-BMDMs were analyzed.

title: Higher susceptibility of males to bleomycin-induced pulmonary inflammation is associated with sex-specific transcriptomic differences in myeloid cells
summary: In this study, we subjected male and female mice to bleomycin-induced lung injury for 14-days. Bronchoalveolar lavage cells were isolated and subjected to RNA-sequencing. Four groups were compared. Saline-Males and females and bleomycin-males and females.
design: Male and female C57BL/6 mice  were oropharyngeally given either saline or bleomycin (4U/Kg body weight) for 14-days. Bronchoalveolar cells were isolated and subjected to RNA-sequencing.

title: Gene expression in MHCII restricted mature thymocytes from Thpok-RKF- or Thpok-RKF+ Thpokfl/flRunx3fl/dYFPCd4-Cre+ mixed Bone marrow chimera.
summary: Thpok-RKF which harbors a mutation in the BTB domain and disrupts the interaction between NuRD complex could not repress CD8 and CD8 lineage genes expression in Thpokfl/flRunx3fl/dYFPCd4-Cre+ from B2m-/- host. However, Thpok-RKF upregulates CD4 expression in these mice.

title: Synergy of chemotherapy and macrophage depletion leads to T cell memory activation and durable triple negative breast cancer regression
summary: Chemotherapy and macrophage depletion leads to T cell memory activation and durable triple negative breast cancer regression in p53 null mouse models.

title: Effects of Conditional Egfr deletion on transcriptome of the mouse cerebral cortex
summary: To investigate the role of Egfr in the cerebreal cortex and hippocampal formation we conditionally deleted it using a floxed allele in combination with the Nestin-cre transgene.  Cortices at E17.5 embryonic stage were harvested and split into rostral and caudal halves and RNA extracted and sequenced
design: Comparison of RNA-seq data between rostral and caudal cortices and hippocampal formation of control brains (EgfrF/+ gentoype) and brain-specific knock of Egfr (Nestin-EgfrF/F).

title: Trerf1 knockout compared to wild type lineage-negative CD127+ bone marrow cells
summary: Mice that lack the transcriptional regulator Trerf1 lack ILC1 in the liver and immature ILC1 in the bone marrow. To determine which pathways are downstream of Trerf1, we sorted lineage-negative CD127+ bone marrow cells (which contain ILC progenitors) from 4 littermate pairs (wild type versus Trerf1 knockout) and examined them by RNAseq.

title: Quantitative analysis of hippocampal transcriptomes of naïve and post-status epilepticus (SE) mouse with or without levetiracetam (LEV).
summary: LEV is known to be involved in neuroprotection via anti-angiogenesis and anti-inflammatory activities against blood-brain barrier dysfunction in the acute phase of epileptogenesis after SE, but the mechanism remains unclear. The purpose of this study is to comprehensively examine the gene expression in hippocampus of LEV-treated and untreated pilocarpine induced (PILO-) SE mouse in order to understand the whole process of early epileptogenesis.

title: DCT SADBE RNA-Seq
summary: In this study we compared the RNA levels before and after treatment with SADBE

title: Mouse models of CMN and comparison to human CMN
summary: In this study we compared the RNA levels of two CMN mouse models.
design: Normal skin, nevi skin and tumor from nevi was taken from both models (Dct-Cre NrasQ61R and Tyr-CreERT2 NrasQ61R)

title: Deletion of the Lmna Gene in Fibroblasts Causes Senescence-Associated Dilated Cardiomyopathy
summary: Deletion of Lmna in PDGFRA+ cells cause dilated cardiomyoapthy.
design: Total RNA obtained from PDGFRA+ cells  isolated from LV of  WT and Pdgfra-Cre: LmnaF/Fmice were  used for total RNA -seq.

title: Gene expression profile of astrocytes derived from the cortex, hippocampus and hypothalamus of mice fed with standard chow (SC) or high-fat high-sugar (HFHS) diet
summary: Astrocytes exhibit a high molecular diversity within the same, as well as across different brain regions. Moreover, astrocytes are characterized by a region-specific role in the regulation of neuronal circuitries, which might be affected by specific diseases. Regarding metabolic control, selective perturbations in astrocytes trigger multiple alterations in energy balance and glucose homeostasis. Using RNA sequencing, we showed that astrocytes have a distinct transcriptomic profile dependent on their anatomical location in the brain, which is affected by hypercaloric diet.
design: C57BL/6JRj mice were exposed to a SC or a HFHS (58%) diet at 8-9 weeks of age for 4 months. Afterwards, hypothalami, hippocampi, and half cortices derived from 2 animals were isolated and pooled together in distinct tubes. A number of 5-7 replicates per each group was used. ACSA2+ astrocytes were isolated from each sample by magnetic-activated cell sorting (MACS), and further processed for RNA-Sequencing analysis.

title: BOD1 regulates the cerebellar IV/V lobe-fastigial nucleus circuit associated with motor coordination
summary: BOD1 plays an important role in  modulating of the cerebellar IV/V lobePCs→FNCaMKIIα+ circuit and provide therapeutic targets for the treatment of ataxia behaviors.

title: RNA-seq analyses of effects of Alpinetin and Zingiberone on hair follicle regeneration
summary: The aim of this study was to determine the effects of Alpinetin (AP) on transcriptome profiles of hair follicle regeneration. Depilation was performed on mice back skin. After 24 hours, the depilated area was treated with 3 mg/ml Alpinetin that were dissolved in 65% ethanol once a day. At day 4 post depilation, skin samples without interfollicular epidermis were obtained for RNAseq. We identified 1567 different expression genes between AP and VC group by using an optimized data analysis workflow.

title: Transcriptome profile of livers from hepatocyte-specific Slc25a34 knockout mice on chow and fast-food diet
summary: Identifcation of diferentially expressed genes in livers of mice maintained on chow diet or fast-food diet when Slc25a34 is deleted in hepatocytes.

title: Ribosome impairment regulates intestinal stem cell identity via ZAKɑ activation
summary: We show that ribosome collisions, induced by Rptor deletion or aminoacid starvation, causes a ZAK alpha mediated identity switch in intestinal stem cells by activating a more fetal-like stem cell signature. This switch also causes changes in metabolic profiles of the cells, which is heavily regulated by RNA translation efficiency of different group of metabolic genes. These observations originate from performing in vitro Riboseq and RNAseq in mouse intestinal organoids, and in vivo Riboseq in Lgr5 expressing intestinal stem cells from WT and Rptor.fl/fl mice.
design: In vitro Ribo-seq and RNAseq in WT-stem cell enriched, WT-stem cell depleted and Rptor fl/fl mouse intestinal organoids. In vitro RNAseq in WT mouse intestinal organoids. In vivo Ribo-seq in Lgr5 expressing intestinal stem cells from WT and Rptor fl/fl mouse.

title: Single cell transcriptome analysis of endocrine pancreas development in mice
summary: In this study, we used SMART-Seq2 single cell analysis to delineate the molecular mechanisms underlying gene expression changes during endocrine pancreas differentiation

title: Direct reprogramming of adult adipose-derived regenerative cells toward cardiomyocytes using six transcriptional factors I
summary: It is widely accepted that adipose-derived regenerative cells (ADRCs) can differentiate into mesodermal lineage cells. However, reprogramming adult ADRCs into mature cardiomyocytes is challenging. We investigated the induction of myocardial differentiation in ADRCs via direct reprogramming using lentiviral gene transfer. We compared gene expression profiling from RNA sequencing of culture ADRCs and embryonic heart organ, and examined candidate transcriptional factors.

title: RNA-seq of sorted KPC Sf3b1-K700E murine PDAC cells
summary: We established a mouse model of KrasG12D, Trp53-/- and Sf3b1-K700E murine pancreatic cancer to elucidate the impact of the SF3B1 mutation found in human PDAC on the KPC mouse model.

title: TRAP-seq of samples isolated from  DHPG-stimulated WT and Fmr1-/y hippocampal slices
summary: Sequencing files from TRAP-seq samples isolated from  DHPG-stimulated WT and Fmr1-/y hippocampal slices
design: Hippocampal slices were prepared from 6 littermate pairs of WT and Fmr1-/y mice expressing EGFP-L10a in CA1 pyr neurons. Slices were stimulated with DHPG to induce LTD and TRAP performed to isolate ribosome-bound mRNAs. Both TRAP samples and samples of the total hippocampal lysate were processed for Illumina sequencing.

title: CX DHPG TRAP-seq
summary: Sequencing files from TRAP-seq samples isolated from  DHPG-stimulated WT and Fmr1-/y hippocampal slices incubated with vehicle or 200 nM CX-5461
design: Hippocampal slices were prepared from 4 littermate pairs of WT and Fmr1-/y mice expressing EGFP-L10a in CA1 pyr neurons. Slices were pre-incubated with 200nM CX-5461 or vehicle then stimulated with DHPG to induce LTD. TRAP was performed to isolate ribosome-bound mRNAs.

title: RNA-seq of liver of mice exposed to varying food availability
summary: RNA-seq of liver of mice exposed to varying food availability

title: The effects of abundant nematode-derived miRNAs on the transcriptome of mouse differentiating Th2 cells
summary: Four microRNAs(miRNAs) highly abundantly secreted by the parasitic nematode Heligmosomoides polygyrus were synthesized (miRVana, Ambion) and transfected repeatedly into differentiating Th2 cells in vitro, individually or in combination. The effects of the different transfection regimens were assessed by RNA sequencing (Illumina).

title: Methods for Culturing Adult CNS Neurons Reveal a CNS Conditioning Effect
summary: To develop a successful, reliable and scalable method for establishing primary cultures of adult neurons from all regions of the brain. Using adult motor cortex cultures, we identify a CNS "conditioning" effect after spinal cord injury.  In vivo conditioning was administered 24hrs prior to cultures.

title: Sensory neurons display cell-type specific vulnerability to loss of axon-glia interactions
summary: In this study we characterized the transcriptional response of sensory neurons to PNS demyelination caused by genetic ablation of glial cells

title: RNAseq of macrophages from MC38 tumors with PtdSer externalization blockade
summary: The goals of this study are to compare NGS-derived transcriptome profiling (RNA-seq) of tumor associated macrophages from WT MC38 tumors and Xkr8 KO tumors

title: Local activation of the complement system mobilizes osteoclast precursors and promotes bone loss
summary: Chemotherapy-induced bone loss depends on cellular senescence and the cell secretory phenotype. To investigate the factors secreted in the senescent microenvironment we have defined a mice model o premature senescence and studied the secreted genes that were differentially expressed in the senescent microenvironment.
design: To define the chemotherapy-induced senescence model, 15-week-old wildtype C57BL/6 male mice were randomly assigned to Control or DoxoR groups. At day 0, mice were injected intraperitoneally with vehicle (saline solution) or 10 mg/kg doxorubicin. 30 days after the treatment mRNA of tibiae and femur (without bone marrow) of 4 Control and 4 Doxorubicin was isolated.

title: RNAseq of macrophages and NK cells from MC38 tumors with PtdSer externalization blockade
summary: The goals of this study are to compare NGS-derived transcriptome profiling (RNA-seq) of tumor associated macrophages from WT MC38 tumors and Tmem30a KO tumors; and NK cells from WT and Xkr8 KO MC38 TILs

title: RNA-sequencing of undifferentiated and differentiated mouse skeletal muscle cells following the depletion of SETD2
summary: undifferentiated mouse skeletal muscle cells (myoblasts) and differentiated mouse skeletal muscle cells (myotubes) were subjected to treatment with siRNAs targeting SETD2 or a non-targeting siRNA (si-Ctrl). Differential gene expression analysis and splicing analysis was performed on the resulting data.
design: 18 samples total, 9 myoblast, 9 myotube each with three conditions (si-Ctrl, si-Setd2#1, and si-Setd2#2) and three biological replicates of each condition

title: Gene-targeted, CREB-mediated induction of ∆FosB controls distinct downstream transcriptional patterns within D1 and D2 medium spiny neurons
summary: ∆FosB, a transcription factor that accumulates in nucleus accumbens (NAc) after exposure to virtually every known rewarding substance, has been shown to directly control gene transcription and behavior downstream of both cocaine and opioid exposure but with potentially different roles in D1 and D2 medium spiny neurons (MSNs). To clarify MSN subtype-specific roles for ∆FosB, and investigate how these subtypes coordinate the actions of distinct classes of addictive drugs, we developed a CRISPR/Cas9-based epigenome editing tool to induce endogenous ∆FosB expression in vivo in the absence of drug exposure and performed RNA-sequencing on bulk male and female NAc tissue.

title: Alpha-synuclein supports type 1 interferon signaling in neurons and brain tissue
summary: To investigate broad difference in gene expression in mice wild-type for or knockout for alpha-synuclein during infeciton, we infected mice via footpad infection with West Nile Virus and measured full brain gene expression.
design: comparitive gene expression profiling using data obtained from RNA-seq in two different mouse lines at one timepoint

title: Next Generation Sequencing Facilitates Quantitative Analysis of Transcriptomes of Skeletal Muscle-Specific Akt Knockout Mice
summary: Impact of knocking out of Akt in fast-twitch muscle on the transcritome was characterized by down-regulation of genes involved in mitochondria and electron transport chain.

title: Murine Model of Familial Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Hepatitis is Mediated by IFN-γ in a Predominantly Hepatic-Intrinsic Manner
summary: Interferon gamma (IFN-γ) is the main cytokine driving Familial Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) organ dysfunction. Hepatocytes are known to have IFN-γ receptor (IFN-γ-R). Blockade of IFN-γ pathway ameliorates FHL hepatitis, in animal models and in humans. However, whether IFN-γ induced hepatitis in FHL is a lymphocyte or liver intrinsic response to the cytokine has yet to be elucidated. We report that IFN-γ-mediated hepatic injury in the murine model of FHL is caused by direct effect on the liver and has a necessary role in recruitment of the inflammatory mediators of injury in FHL: inflammatory monocytes and CD8+ effector memory T lymphocytes (CD8+ CD44hi CD62Llo) (Tem).
design: Fresh mouse liver segments were stored in RNAlater® solution (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at -20°C and thawed for RNA extraction at later date. RNA extraction was performed in livers of 4 mice from the BM IFNgR+/+ and host IFNgR -/- group and 4 mice from the BM IFNgR+/+ and host IFNgR+/+ group using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit protocol from approximately 30mg of homogenized tissue according to manufacturer instructions.

title: Transcriptomics profiling of white adipose tissue of macrophage-specific Gja1 Knockout mice fed a normal chow diet (NCD) and high fat diet (HFD)
summary: Adipose mRNA profiles of wild-type and Gja1 knockout (tamoxifen-induced Csf1r-CreER/ Gja1(floxed/floxed)) mice were generated by deep sequencing.
design: White adipose tissue mRNA profiles of wild-type (WT) and Macrophage specific Gja1 KO (KO) mice after feeding NCD and HFD were generated by deep sequencing. Three biological replicates were analyzed for each of four conditions.

title: Tumor-associated Tregs obstruct anti-tumor immunity by promoting T cell dysfunction and restricting clonal diversity in tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells
summary: We investigated how accumulation of Tregs contributes to T cell dysfunction and clonal constriction of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells. Resected melanoma atissues from tumor-bearing mice were analyzed. The clonal diversity of tumor-associated CD8+ T cells were evaluated by single-cell TCR sequencing respectively, at early or advanced tumor stages or under Treg depletion conditions. TCR-sequencing revealed a clonal shrinkage of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells as tumor progressed, which was associated with reduced survival profile concomitant to increasing Treg proportions.

title: Crosstalk between CYP2E1 and PPARα substrates and agonists modulate adipose browning and obesity
summary: We report the discrepancy of hepatic mRNA expression in Cyp2e1 widetype and knockout mice by application of RNA-seq technology.

title: Translational regulation of T follicular helper cell differentiation
summary: We report the translational regulation of murine TFH cells, showing that they contain high levels of translation initiation factor eIF4E, which we show is essential for translation of TFH cell differentiation and function mRNAs.

title: Identification and characterization of BEND2 as a novel and key regulator of meiosis during mouse spermatogenesis
summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.

title: Identification and characterization of BEND2 as a novel and key regulator of meiosis during mouse spermatogenesis [RNA-seq]
summary: To describe the changes of transcriptome in Bend2 knockout mice, we conducted RNA-seq analyses by using leptotene and zygotene spermatocytes from Bend2 WT and KO mice. We found BEND2 contributes to shutting down the mitotic program and to activating or enhancing the meiotic and post-meiotic program of spermatogenic cells.

title: Molecular signatures of in-situ to invasive progression for basal-like breast cancers: An integrated mouse model and human tumor study [mouse]
summary: This study identifies progression in breast ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) as it progresses towards triple negative invasive breast cancer (TNBC).

title: Gene expression analysis of  mouse pancreas carrying Prox1 ectopic acinar expression
summary: RNA sequencing was used to identify gene expression changes in pancreatic acinar cells with ectopic expression of the homeodomain transcription factor Prox1

title: Gene expression analysis of E13.5 Prox1-deficient mouse embryonic pancreas
summary: RNA sequencing was used to identify gene expression changes in the pancreas of E13.5 Prox1-nullyzygous mouse embryos.
design: The pancreas E13.5 control embryos (wildtype) and Prox1-nullyzygous embryos (Prox1 GFPCre/D) was dissected and pooled (each sample pool contained 5-6 individual pancreata; 3 "control" pools and 3 "mutant" pools were processed for RNA extraction using an RNAeasy Micro Kit (Qiagen). RNA quality was assesed using the Agilent 2100 bioanalyzer. Six sequencing libraries (3 "control" and 3 "mutant")  were made usingTruSeq mRNA-Seq library prep. NextSeq high througput was used for sequencng.

title: RNAseq on APAP mice flow sorted macrophages at 72h
summary: RNAseq of flow sorted macrophages 72h after APAP. Cxcr4 expression induced on subpopulation of macrophages after APAP.

title: RNA-Sequencing Facilitates Quantitative Analysis of Control and Mettl3 Knockdown LPS-induced Macrophage Transcriptomes
summary: The goal of this study is to investigate the potential role of Mettl3 in the innate immune response by RNA-seq

title: The effect of 2HG level on transcriptome at different stages of male mouse meiosis
summary: We found that L2-hydroxyglutarate (2HG) level is 15 times higher in pachytene-diplotene (PD) stage as compared to leptotene-zygotene (LZ) stage. Since 2HG shows epigenetic effects we asked if the addition of 2HG to LZ cells or the decrease of 2HG level in PD cells will cause changes in gene expression.

title: Aspergillus fumigatus-induced transcriptional changes on murine eosinophils
summary: Eosinophilia is associated with various persisting inflammatory diseases and often coincides with chronic fungal infections or fungal allergy as in case of allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA). However, the interactions between eosinophils and fungal pathogen leading to release of inflammatory mediators from eosinophils are poorly understood. Therefore, we established a co-culture system of mouse bone marrow derived eosinophils (BMDE) with Aspergillus fumigatus (Af) that we used in part to analyse transcriptional regulation induced by Af.
design: Transcriptional profile of mouse bone marrow derived eosinophils either cultured alone or co-cultured with Aspergillus fumigatus.

title: Single cell RNAseq of small intestinal stromal cells
summary: We used scRNAseq approaches (Smartseq2 and 10X Genomics) to investigate the diversity of small intestinal stromal cells.

title: Cytokines and lipid mediators of inflammation in lungs of SARS-CoV-2 infected mice
summary: We investigared the gene expression response of K18-ACE2 mices to Sars-Cov-2 infection. We compared gene expression profiles of control and infected mices at different time points as well as the infection from the Wuhan and Delta strains

title: The effect of Asari Radix et Rhizoma on hematopoietic stem cells in C57BL/6 mouse.
summary: To investigate the toxicity of long-term treatment with Asari Radix et Rhizoma on hematopoietic cells, we have performed the 28 days gavage administration of AR in C57BL/6 mouse. Then, we have harvested the RBC lysed bone marrow cells, and analyzed the RNA-seq. analysis.

title: Mouse SINE B2 elements function as IFN-inducible enhancer elements [RNA-Seq]
summary: B2_Mm2 acts as a STAT1 binding site and interferon inducible enhancer of the nearbby interferon-stimulated gene Dicer1 during an innate immune response (IFNG stimulated). J774 knockouts deficient of B2_Mm2 were also found to have downregulated expression of Serpina3f and Serpina3g, indicating that B2_Mm2 acts as an enhancer on these nearby genes likely due to its capability as a CTCF-binding site.
design: Transcriptional profiling (RNA-seq) of wildtype mouse cell lines (J774) that were either untreated or stimulated with 100 ng/mL interferon gamma (IFNG) for 4h. RNA-seq is also provided from clonal B2 knockout J774 lines that were modified using CRISPR Cas9 and a pair of gRNAs targetting the B2_Mma2 element in the first intron of Dicer1 on chr12.

title: transcriptome analysis  of whole lung tissue from anti-PD-1 therapy-treated mice
summary: IIn contrast to the young mice treated with anti-PD-1 therapy, aged mice exhibited immune-related adverse event (irAE)-like symptoms in the lung when treated with anti-PD-1 therapy. To understand the molecular events underlying the development of anti-PD-1 therapy-induced irAE, we employed deep RNA sequencing of whole lung transcript from anti-PD-1 therapy-treated young and aged mice. In order to further evaluate the effect of IL-21 signal on PD-1-blockade-mediated immune response, gene expression profile in lung tissue from aged mice twith the blockade of IL-21 activity was also assessed.
design: Whole lung transcripts were obtained from melanoma-bearing young or aged mice treated anti-PD-1 Ab, aged mice treated with rat control Ab, and aged mice similtaneously treated with anti-PD-1 Ab and anti-IL-21 receptor in vivo. Each gene expression profile was analyzed by RNA sequencing, and the differential gene expressions in whole lung tissues among those stimulatory conditions were assessed.
